About Patrimoine canadien -- Canadian Heritage
----------------------------------------------

Patrimoine canadien et ses organismes du portefeuille jouent un rôle vital dans la vie culturelle, civique et économique des Canadiens. Les arts, la culture et le patrimoine représentent 54,6 milliards de dollars en activité économique et emploient plus de 630 000 personnes dans de nombreux secteurs d'activité tels que le film et la vidéo, la radiodiffusion, la musique, l'édition, les archives, les arts de la scène, les établissements du patrimoine, les festivals et les célébrations.  
  
Mandat  
  
Patrimoine canadien favorise un environnement dans lequel tous les Canadiens profitent pleinement d'expériences culturelles dynamiques, célèbrent leur histoire et leur patrimoine, et contribuent à bâtir des communautés créatives. Nous voyons un Canada qui investit dans l'avenir en soutenant les arts, nos deux langues officielles et nos athlètes. Nous voyons un Canada confiant dans un monde offrant de multiples choix, un Canada à l'avant-garde de l'économie créative et un chef de file dans le monde numérique.  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
  
Canadian Heritage and its portfolio organizations play a vital role in the cultural, civic and economic life of Canadians. Arts, culture and heritage represent $54.6 billion in the Canadian economy and more than 630,000 jobs in sectors such as film and video, broadcasting, music, publishing, archives, performing arts, heritage institutions, festivals and celebrations.  
  
Mandate  
  
Canadian Heritage promotes an environment in which all Canadians take full advantage of dynamic cultural experiences, celebrating our history and heritage, and participating in building creative communities. We see a Canada that invests in the future by supporting the arts, our two official languages and our athletes: A Canada that is confident in a world of choice, at the forefront of the creative economy and a leader in the digital world.

What types of pipeline support services does MTS Quanta offer?

MTS Quanta provides a comprehensive range of pipeline support services, including permitting, inspection, LiDAR services, field services, surveying, integrity management, aerial photogrammetry, and right-of-way acquisition. Our expertise in these areas ensures that we can meet the diverse needs of our clients in the energy and infrastructure sectors.

How does MTS Quanta ensure compliance with regulatory requirements during pipeline projects?

MTS Quanta prioritizes compliance with all relevant local, state, and federal regulations. Our permitting team works closely with regulatory agencies to secure necessary permits and ensure that all project activities adhere to legal standards. Additionally, our inspection services include thorough assessments to verify compliance with safety and environmental regulations throughout the project lifecycle.

What is LiDAR, and how does MTS Quanta utilize it in pipeline projects?

LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) is a remote sensing technology that uses laser light to measure distances and create detailed 3D models of the terrain. MTS Quanta employs LiDAR to conduct precise surveys for pipeline routes, enabling accurate mapping of the landscape and identification of potential obstacles. This technology enhances project planning and execution by providing high-resolution data that supports decision-making.

Can MTS Quanta assist with right-of-way acquisition for pipeline projects?

Yes, MTS Quanta offers right-of-way acquisition services as part of our pipeline support solutions. Our experienced team works diligently to negotiate and secure the necessary land access agreements with property owners, ensuring that projects can proceed smoothly and without delays. We understand the complexities involved in right-of-way acquisition and strive to facilitate a transparent and efficient process.

What industries does MTS Quanta serve with its pipeline support services?

MTS Quanta serves a variety of industries, primarily focusing on the energy sector, including oil and gas, renewable energy, and utility infrastructure. Our services are designed to support companies involved in pipeline construction, maintenance, and integrity management, ensuring that they can operate safely and efficiently in their respective markets.

How does MTS Quanta approach integrity management for pipelines?

MTS Quanta takes a proactive approach to integrity management by employing a combination of advanced inspection techniques, data analysis, and risk assessment methodologies. Our team conducts regular inspections and monitoring to identify potential issues before they escalate, ensuring the safety and reliability of pipeline operations. We also provide clients with detailed reports and recommendations for maintaining pipeline integrity over time.

Company owners Guido and Simona oversee the entire process to ensure the highest quality and safety standards are maintained. Their gelato and sorbet are made using pure, fresh ingredients, and are free from artificial flavors, colors, growth hormones, allergens, and trans fat.  
  
G.S. Gelato's state-of-the-art manufacturing facility is Kosher Certified and has USDA Organic and Certified Vegan capabilities.  
  
For more information on how G.S. Gelato can grow your business, please visit https://gsgelato.com.

What services does Health Wildcatters offer to startups?

Health Wildcatters provides a range of services tailored to support startups, particularly in the healthcare sector. These services include mentorship from industry experts, access to seed stage investments, networking opportunities, and educational workshops. Additionally, we offer coworking spaces and office leasing options that foster collaboration and innovation among entrepreneurs.

How can I apply to join the Health Wildcatters accelerator program?

To apply for the Health Wildcatters accelerator program, interested startups should visit our website and complete the application form available under the 'Accelerator' section. We review applications on a rolling basis, and selected startups will be invited for interviews. Our program is designed for early-stage healthcare startups looking to scale their business with the help of experienced mentors and resources.

What types of companies does Health Wildcatters support?

Health Wildcatters primarily supports healthcare startups, including those focused on digital health, medical devices, biotechnology, and health services. We are particularly interested in innovative solutions that improve patient care, enhance healthcare delivery, or address significant challenges in the healthcare industry. Our goal is to foster innovation that can lead to impactful changes in health and wellness.

What amenities are included in the coworking space at Health Wildcatters?

The coworking space at Health Wildcatters is designed to provide a productive and collaborative environment for entrepreneurs. Amenities include high-speed internet, meeting rooms, private offices, event spaces, and access to kitchen facilities. Additionally, members benefit from networking events, workshops, and mentorship opportunities that can help accelerate their business growth.

Is there a cost associated with leasing office space at Health Wildcatters?

Yes, there is a cost associated with leasing office space at Health Wildcatters. Pricing varies based on the type of space you choose, whether it's a dedicated desk, private office, or flexible coworking arrangement. For detailed pricing information and to schedule a tour of our facilities, please visit our office space page on the website or contact our team directly.

What is the duration of the accelerator program at Health Wildcatters?

The accelerator program at Health Wildcatters typically lasts for 12 weeks. During this time, selected startups participate in intensive mentorship sessions, workshops, and networking events designed to refine their business models, develop their products, and prepare for investor pitches. At the end of the program, startups have the opportunity to present their progress to a panel of investors during a demo day.

About Center For Design Innovation
----------------------------------

The Center for Design Innovation (CDI) is the engine driving North Carolina's discovery economy from the Piedmont Triad Region - long known for innovation in research, manufacturing and the arts. Designated by the University of North Carolina (UNC) General Administration to be a generator of interdisciplinary research, discovery and innovation that crosses creative, technical and scientific boundaries, the Center builds bridges between local UNC and private universities, the community college system, the greater local community, the state of North Carolina and beyond. Resonating at the nexus of creativity, advanced technology, and thought leadership, the Center harnesses new ideas and technologies to shape the future. Part advanced technology and design lab, maker space, convening space, and performance space, the Center’s world-class facility serves as a uniquely adaptable research and learning environment for the artist, designer, engineer, and entrepreneur in each of us.

Are there any special events or festivals hosted by Belhaven Brewery?

These events often include beer tastings, brewery tours, and community gatherings. Visitors can check the brewery's website or social media pages for updates on upcoming events and festivals.

How can I purchase Belhaven beers if I am not in Scotland?

Belhaven Brewery has a growing international presence, and their beers can often be found in select retailers and bars outside of Scotland. Additionally, many online retailers offer shipping options for Belhaven beers. MEGGLE is a family-run international dairy processing company. We stand for tradition, innovation, quality and success. In addition, powdered milk products are produced and distributed worldwide as speciality goods for the processing pharmaceutical and food industries.MEGGLE has production sites, sales offices and agencies in 25 countries across the globe. About Emission Resource Group, LLC
----------------------------------

“Our Mission is to be the leading global innovator, developer and provider of efficient and environmentally sound energy production, and evolve as a major contributor to national as well as global efforts for both energy independence and environmental protection.”  
  
Emission Resource Group’s (ERG) primary focus over the last three decades has been the research and design of “green” technologies in the reclamation of solid municipal waste (WTE) industry. Receiving global recognition as an industry leader in safe environmentally friendly “Green” renewable energy, ERG’s patented technology has revolutionized the market and has quickly become the industry standard for the gasification process.  
  
Although ERG continues to operate this segment of business, ERG has transitioned to focus on the manufacturing and installation of our state of the art WTE systems. ERG’s WTE power plants are a combination of sub-component systems designed for “Green” gasification. These systems in conjunction with ERG’s patented MicroMist Scrubber technology virtually eliminates all harmful emissions/dioxins released to the atmosphere through WTE exhaust. ERG’s WTE facilities deliver clean, renewable electric power to major utilities for distribution to hundreds of thousands of homes and businesses globally.

The firm has a broad civil practice, with emphasis on commercial litigation, construction and insurance coverage litigation, employment law, real estate, corporate, financial transactions, banking, governmental relations, creditor’s rights in bankruptcy, probate and estate planning, government affairs and administrative law. Clients of the firm include some of the most distinguished individuals and corporate names in Nevada, as well as many regional, national, and international companies. This hands-on approach not only enriches the learning experience but also prepares graduates for successful careers in various sectors, including mental health, education, and organizational psychology. Overall, the UQ School of Psychology stands out as a leader in the field, dedicated to shaping the future of psychology through exceptional education and impactful research.

About MEVGAL USA
----------------

MEVGAL USA, a subsidiary of MEVGAL S.A.(a third generation family owned and operated business), is the sole importer of authentic Greek MEVGAL dairy products in America. We are fortunate to be able to share with you our traditions of Mediterranean heritage and cuisine, and are pleased to present to you our finest cheeses made out of fresh Greek milk.  
  
MEVGAL is the largest dairy company of Northern Greece and the third largest producer of fresh dairy products in the country.  
  
MEVGAL produces and sells:  
  
Fresh pasteurized milk  
Traditional and Western Style Yogurt  
Cheese Products  
Desserts, rice puddings, gelatin deserts and milk creams  
Cholesterol-free dairy products  
Natural juices  
  
Since 1950 MEVGAL has been active in Macedonia-Greece, the heartland of fresh milk, where 67% of Greece’s fresh milk is being produced. With more than 1600 farms located close to MEVGAL facilities, meeting the national demand for high-quality milk is, therefore, guaranteed. The proximity to the farms ensures the fast delivery of the fresh milk to MEVGAL’s plant, the immediate processing and the freshness of the final product.  
  
As a result of its excellent fresh raw milk, state-of-the-art technology applied in the production lines (HACCP system, ISO/BRC/GMO certifications), well-organized sales channel and experienced personnel, MEVGAL is distributing its products through more than 22,000 small and large points of sale in Greece while at the same time exports to 25 countries around the world.

About Western Carolina University
---------------------------------

Western Carolina University (WCU), nestled in the picturesque Blue Ridge and Great Smoky Mountains of Cullowhee, North Carolina, offers a unique blend of academic excellence and outdoor adventure. As the westernmost institution in the University of North Carolina System, WCU boasts a sprawling 600-acre campus and an instructional site at Biltmore Park in Asheville. With over 120 undergraduate and more than 40 graduate programs, the university is consistently recognized by U.S. News & World Report as one of the top public universities in the South, particularly noted for its exceptional value through the NC Promise program, which significantly lowers tuition costs for both in-state and out-of-state students.  
  
WCU is not just about academics; it fosters a vibrant campus life with over 170 student organizations, including Greek life, cultural groups like the Black Student Union and Latino Appreciation Student Organization, and numerous club and intramural sports. Students are encouraged to engage in meaningful community service and leadership opportunities, enhancing their college experience through volunteer projects and study abroad programs. The university's commitment to holistic education is further reflected in its state-of-the-art fitness facilities, which include a climbing wall, multi-purpose courts, and an extensive trail system.  
  
For those interested in the academic staff, a comprehensive Western Carolina University teachers list is available, showcasing the dedicated faculty committed to student success. Whether you’re drawn by the academic programs, the vibrant campus culture, or the breathtaking natural surroundings, WCU provides an enriching environment for personal and academic growth.

We are fully certified (ISO 9001/AD 2000A4) to include modification shop in Gelsenkirchen, Germany, which provides adaption and modification to valves, approved by principle suppliers.  
  
In addition we hold substantial stocks of over 220,000 valves in Germany and Holland, with Project Management offices within UK, Germany and The Netherlands.  
  
From our UK Offices, we not only manage projects with Engineering Companies based in the UK, but also coordinate with International agents and clients within the Middle East, North Africa and Eastern Europe.

About Sam's Xpress Car Wash, LLC
--------------------------------

Sam’s Xpress®Car Wash is headquartered in Matthews, NC.  
  
The first location opened on December 3, 2012 in Fort Mill, South Carolina. Since then, we have successfully opened multiple sites and are continuing to grow rapidly.  
  
At Sam’s Xpress®Car Wash we are building our company on providing amazing customer service, a dynamic culture where we instill a sense of fun and energy into everything we do; all while maintaining an incredible focus on our employees. We employ over 20 employees per site with plenty of advancement opportunities. Our team is professionally trained and dedicated to exceed customer expectations. We promote and expect a courteous and friendly work environment with our team showing a positive attitude and an attention to detail. All employees at Sam’s Xpress®Car Wash are responsible for providing outstanding experience for our customers and a safe, enjoyable working environment.  
  
We use state-of-the-art, user-friendly equipment and are continuously making improvements to better the environment and your car washing experience. Our top-notch equipment allows us to recycle 100% of the water used and reuse 90% of what is recycled. Each car wash site saves about 12 million gallons of fresh water per year. All of our chemicals are environmentally friendly and biodegradable, making the entire car wash experience Eco-friendly. From saving energy through the works of the car wash to our energy saving dryers in the bathroom facilities, Sam’s Xpress® is determined to keep our environment safe and clean!  
  
Not only do we focus on saving our environment, but we are also dedicated to lending a helping hand in the community. Sam’s Xpress®Car Wash is involved with local schools, community events, and the Adopt-A-Stream cleanup program. Check out our community page to see more . We also offer an easy fundraising program to help support non-profit organizations!  
  
Sam’s Xpress®Car Wash is setting the car wash standard for Quality, Value and Service.

-------------------------------

The Anti-Recidivism Coalition (ARC) seeks to accomplish this Mission in a three-fold approach: (1) to advocate for fair and just policies that: reduce crime, decrease the use of incarceration, and serve the needs and well-being of formerly incarcerated people; (2) to provide services and resources to rebuild broken men and women affected by the criminal justice system that improves outcomes; and (3) to build healthier communities by returning motivated, mentally prepared, and high character men and women from incarceration to crime ridden neighborhoods to serve as ambassadors for change. In brief, ARC is a support network, a connection to services and support, and an advocate for just and fair policies.

About St Andrews Radio

St Andrews Radio (STAR) is the vibrant heartbeat of the University of St Andrews, having first launched in February 2005. As the official radio station of the university, STAR broadcasts daily from 10 AM to midnight, offering a diverse range of programming that caters to the eclectic tastes of its student body and the wider community. With a dedicated committee of 20 students and a dynamic roster of over 250 presenters, newsreaders, and producers, STAR fosters a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and innovation in broadcasting.  
  
The station serves not only as a platform for music and entertainment but also as a vital source of news and information relevant to the university and local community. STAR organizes five major events each year, showcasing talent and engaging listeners, while also collaborating with two of St Andrews' largest events, further solidifying its presence in the local cultural landscape. In addition to live broadcasting, STAR publishes "Hearing Aid," a music magazine that appears twice a semester in both online and print formats, providing insights into the latest trends and happenings in the music scene.  
  
The 2013/14 academic year marked a significant milestone for STAR, achieving record listening figures and an influx of new show sign-ups, reflecting its growing influence and popularity. Utilizing modern broadcasting technologies, STAR ensures high-quality audio and an engaging listening experience for its audience. With an active online presence through its website and social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter, St Andrews Radio continues to connect with listeners, making it an essential part of the university's vibrant community.

About Passaic Metal & Building Supplies Co.

We excel in spiral duct systems and architectural roofing products used in new buildings and historic restorations. Our founder, Max Gurtman, was a tin knocker who ran one of the first union shops in New Jersey. As the shop grew, he started supplying some of the smaller shops with materials, which led him to open Passaic Metal. His son Lawrence Gurtman founded PAMPCO in 1933 as a sheet metal wholesaler and distributor. We expanded again in 1973 when his sons Frank and Alan took over and added roofing and siding products for both residential and commercial markets plus pre-fabricated sheet metal and accessories. New locations were opened in Andover, N.J. and Fishkill, N.Y. Frank and Alan worked side by side until Alan passed away in 2001. Finally, Frank’s son, Scott joined the team.  
  
Today, PAMPCO operates seven companies and has expanded its product offerings to include HVAC equipment, fireplaces and tapered roofing services. Customers prefer us because we have one of the largest inventories with a tremendous staff. We operate a complete fleet of trucks, including cranes, booms and moffetts. Each conveniently located branch carries an extensive inventory of HVAC equipment and accessories, sheet metal, roofing, siding and fireplaces to serve our local customers’ needs.

About FREITAG
-------------

THE FREITAG STORY  
  
In 1993, graphic designers Markus and Daniel Freitag were looking for a functional, water-repellent and robust bag to hold their creative work. Inspired by the multicolored heavy traffic that rumbled through the Zurich transit intersection in front of their flat, they developed a messenger bag from used truck tarpaulins, discarded bicycle inner tubes and car seat belts. This is how the first FREITAG bags took shape in the living room of their shared apartment – each one recycled, each one unique.  
  
With their innovation, the brothers inadvertently triggered a seismic event in the world of bag making. Its tremors have since made themselves felt in Zurich and the cities of Europe and spread all the way to Asia, making FREITAG the unofficial outfitter of all urban, bike-riding individualists.  
  
The tarp bag headquarters have been located at the Noerd industrial complex in Zurich-Oerlikon since 2011. Here, on premises measuring over 80,000 square feet in area, the tarps are disassembled and washed and cut to size by hand. FREITAG thinks and acts in cycles – and that is evident in the factory as well: Each step and process is looked at not only from the aspect of profitability but also through the eyes of FREITAG.  
  
In 2014, Daniel and Markus Freitag gave themselves a new raw material on which to flex their creative muscles: F-ABRIC. Their rugged, completely compostable textiles are based on vegetable fibers produced using a minimum of resources within an area of 2500 kilometers form the factory.

### Frequently Asked Questions about FREITAG

Who is the CEO of FREITAG?

Bhavini Mistry is the CEO of FREITAG. To contact Bhavini Mistry email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
 or [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

Who are the decision makers in FREITAG?

The decision makers in FREITAG are Barbara Portaluri, Bianca Fleischmann, Christian Gehrlein, etc. Click to Find [FREITAG decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=FREITAG&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What materials does FREITAG use for its products?

FREITAG specializes in creating bags and accessories from recycled materials, primarily using truck tarpaulins (LKW-Planen), seat belts, and bicycle inner tubes. This commitment to recycling not only ensures durability and water resistance but also contributes to a circular economy by repurposing materials that would otherwise go to waste.

How does FREITAG ensure the quality and durability of its products?

FREITAG products are crafted from high-quality, robust materials that are designed to withstand the rigors of daily use. Each bag is handmade in Switzerland, where skilled artisans meticulously inspect and assemble each item. The use of truck tarpaulins, which are built to endure harsh weather conditions, guarantees that FREITAG bags are both functional and long-lasting.

What is the concept of Holacracy that FREITAG follows?

Holacracy is a decentralized management system that FREITAG has adopted to promote self-organization and empower employees. This approach allows team members to take ownership of their roles and responsibilities, fostering a collaborative work environment. By implementing Holacracy, FREITAG aims to enhance creativity and innovation within the company while maintaining a clear structure for decision-making.

Can I customize my FREITAG bag?

Yes, FREITAG offers a customization option for certain products through their 'FREITAG Custom' service. Customers can choose from a variety of colors and designs based on the available truck tarpains, allowing them to create a unique bag that reflects their personal style. This service emphasizes FREITAG's commitment to individuality and sustainability.

What industries does FREITAG support with its products?

FREITAG primarily focuses on the fashion and accessories industry, but its products are also popular among outdoor enthusiasts, urban commuters, and environmentally conscious consumers. The brand's emphasis on sustainability and recycling resonates with individuals and organizations looking to reduce their environmental footprint while enjoying high-quality, functional products.

How does FREITAG contribute to sustainability and the circular economy?

FREITAG is dedicated to sustainability through its use of recycled materials and its commitment to a circular economy. By transforming discarded truck tarpaulins into stylish and functional bags, FREITAG reduces waste and promotes responsible consumption. The company also encourages customers to return their used FREITAG products for recycling, further supporting the lifecycle of materials and minimizing environmental impact.

As a privately-owned company, we've spent over 50 years perfecting our craft and are proud to be one of the leading global dairy suppliers, distributing over 1,100,000 MT of dairy products per annum.  
  
Our diverse product range consists of products such as full cream milk powder, skimmed milk powder, buttermilk powder, whey powder, butter, butter oil / AMF, cheddar, Gouda, Edam, Emmental, mozzarella, casein, caseinates, MPC, WPC, infant milk powders, liquid milk products and concentrates. Our accounts are multinationals in the food industry, dairy producers and processors, government institutions, and importers/distributors all over the globe, and we're committed to delivering exceptional service to each and every one.  
  
We believe that our success stems from our pro-active and service-oriented market approach, our drive for excellence, our global presence, and our extensive market and product knowledge. We enjoy an exclusive vantage point, positioned between dairy customers and suppliers, generating unique perspectives that inspire us to see the extraordinary.  
  
We're a team of over 360 employees spread across 14 offices worldwide, and we believe that our culture of teamwork, passion, and dedication has been instrumental in our growth. We thrive on close collaboration and long-term relationships with our partners, honing our skills and focusing on strategic alignment. We strive for better every single day, and we're committed to delivering better products, better services, and informed insights about the industry to our customers and suppliers alike: Together for Better.  
  
At Interfood Group, we're not just focused on business success – we're committed to contributing to a sustainable planet. We believe that everyone should be able to enjoy food responsibly, both now and in the future, and we're proud to be doing our part to make that a reality.

About Kristin Kwasnik

Kristin Kwasnik serves as the Regional Vice President and Education Portfolio Lead for Professional Services at Salesforce, where she plays a pivotal role in shaping the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for Higher Education. With a deep-seated passion for leveraging technology to enhance educational outcomes, Kristin is committed to empowering nonprofit educational organizations to optimize their operations and drive efficiencies through innovative solutions. Her expertise lies not only in account management and customer service but also in the strategic integration of Software as a Service (SaaS) models that cater specifically to the unique needs of the education sector.  
  
In her current role, Kristin leads a dynamic team focused on delivering tailored professional services that enable higher education institutions to harness the full potential of Salesforce’s robust CRM capabilities. She is instrumental in developing key projects that align with the mission of lifelong learning, ensuring that educational organizations can effectively engage with students and stakeholders alike. By fostering strong relationships and understanding the intricacies of the education landscape, Kristin is adept at identifying opportunities for growth and transformation within her portfolio.  
  
Kristin's proficiency in event planning and marketing further enhances her ability to connect with clients and drive impactful initiatives. Her strategic vision is complemented by her hands-on experience in sales, where she has consistently demonstrated her ability to exceed targets and deliver exceptional customer experiences. As a thought leader in the intersection of technology and education, Kristin Kwasnik is dedicated to championing the cause of accessible, high-quality education for all, making her a vital asset to Salesforce and the broader educational community.

About Marie Curie Alumni Association
------------------------------------

The Marie Curie Alumni Association (MCAA) is an association of researchers who have benefitted or are benefiting from a Marie Curie Action (recently renamed “Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions” under the “Excellent Science” pillar of EU’s Horizon 2020 Programme for Research). Researchers on the verge of working on a Marie Curie project are also eligible to join. The main objective of the association is to provide its members with a space where they can share experiences and interests.  
  
Membership of the MCAA is open to past and current beneficiaries of the European Commission’s successive Marie Curie Actions (and earlier programmes) encouraging international mobility for researchers at: https://www.mariecuriealumni.eu/user/register

About Ruder Finn
----------------

Ruder Finn, Inc. is one of the world's largest independent global communications and creative agencies with dual headquarters in the U.S. and China. Founded in 1948, Ruder Finn serves the global and local communication needs of over 250 corporations, governments, non-profit organizations and startups. The agency is organized around four strategic pillars that reflect its core areas of expertise: Health & Wellness, Corporate Reputation & Transformation, Technology & Innovation, and Consumer Connections. RFI Studios, the agency's full-service digital practice, leads the industry in designing and developing internal collaboration platforms, building conversations and communities around brands, and staying top-of-mind in the world of mobile applications. Ruder Finn's work, talent and culture have received industry-wide recognition, featuring awards from the Cannes Health Lions, the Clio’s, the SABRE Awards, the Big Apples and the PRWeek Awards. In 2016, Bulldog Reporter named Ruder Finn Large and Tech Agency of the Year, and PR News' has listed Ruder Finn as one of the Top Places to Work in PR for three years in a row. What services does TubeMogul offer for video advertising?

TubeMogul provides a comprehensive suite of services for video advertising, including programmatic video buying, real-time media buying, and video distribution across various platforms. Their demand-side platform (DSP) enables brands to manage their video ad campaigns efficiently, ensuring optimal reach and engagement with target audiences.

How does TubeMogul ensure brand safety in advertising?

TubeMogul prioritizes brand safety by implementing advanced verification tools and partnerships with industry-leading safety providers. This ensures that ads are placed in appropriate environments, protecting brands from potential reputational risks. Additionally, advertisers can customize their safety settings to align with their specific brand guidelines.

What industries does TubeMogul support with its advertising solutions?

TubeMogul supports a wide range of industries, including retail, automotive, entertainment, technology, and consumer goods. Their platform is designed to cater to the unique advertising needs of each sector, allowing brands to effectively reach their target audiences through tailored video advertising strategies.

Can TubeMogul help with cross-platform video advertising?

Yes, TubeMogul specializes in cross-platform video advertising, allowing brands to distribute their video content across various channels, including social media, websites, and streaming services. This multi-channel approach helps brands maximize their reach and engagement, ensuring that their messages resonate with audiences wherever they are.

What is programmatic video advertising, and how does TubeMogul facilitate it?

Programmatic video advertising refers to the automated buying and selling of video ad inventory through technology platforms. TubeMogul facilitates this process by providing a robust DSP that enables advertisers to bid on video ad placements in real-time, optimize their campaigns based on performance data, and target specific audience segments effectively.

How can brands measure the effectiveness of their video advertising campaigns with TubeMogul?

TubeMogul offers comprehensive analytics and reporting tools that allow brands to measure the effectiveness of their video advertising campaigns. Advertisers can track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as viewability, engagement rates, and conversion metrics. This data-driven approach enables brands to make informed decisions and optimize their campaigns for better results.

About Rock Prairie Behavioral Health
------------------------------------

Rock Prairie Behavioral Health is an acute behavioral health hospital serving adolescents, adults and seniors located in College Station, TX. We provide a structured, therapeutic and safe environment for those patients who require acute care with psychiatric, mental or behavioral challenges. Our multidisciplinary team approach makes use of a highly-trained medical and professional staff to help individuals find the self-acceptance and confidence they need to be successful in their families, communities, workplaces and schools.Rock Prairie Behavioral Health is open for free assessments and admissions seven days a week, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Assessments are conducted by our clinicians free of charge and can be scheduled by anyone in need of assistance. Physician referrals are not required in order to receive an assessment.For a free confidential assessment, call: (979) 703-8848The goal of our inpatient program is to effectively treat adolescents, adults and senior citizens affected by mental illness to the extent that care in the community is not sufficient. We provide assessment, diagnosis and rapid stabilization of acute psychiatric issues with referrals to less intensive, appropriate levels of follow-up care and support.Our Intensive Outpatient program provides more services under a licensed mental health professional than is typically available in a traditional visit to a therapist or psychiatrist. Patients will come to structured groups 3 to 5 days a week for a few hours each time.Our Partial Hospitalization program is a physician led service and often serves as a step down from inpatient hospital care, or can serve to help those whose immediate safety and well-being is not an immediate concern. Patients come to this program 4 or 5 days a week during the day and return to their homes or communities in the evening.

About DON'T NOD Montréal
------------------------

Créé en 2008, DON’T NOD est un studio indépendant de création et de développement de jeux vidéo « AA » de genres populaires, aventure (Life is Strange, Tell me Why, Twin Mirror), action (Remember Me) et jeux de rôle (Vampyr). Chaque nouveau jeu est une création originale avec une expérience narrative et une mécanique de jeu uniques.  
  
En 2020, DON’T NOD a ouvert sa première filiale à l'international avec DON’T NOD Montréal.  
  
À DON’T NOD Montréal, nous célébrons la diversité et l'inclusivité dans nos jeux, mais aussi dans nos équipes. Nous sommes respectueux(-euses) des principes d'égalité des chances à l'emploi, et c'est pour cela que nous encourageons les femmes, les personnes de toutes orientations sexuelles et identités de genre, les personnes autochtones, en situation de handicap, les minorités visibles, ainsi que toute autre personne pouvant contribuer à la diversité de notre studio à poser leur candidature à nos postes.  
  
🍁🎮  
  
Created in 2008, DON’T NOD is an independent studio which creates and develop AA games in various genres : adventure (Life is Strange, Tell Me Why, Twin Mirror), action (Remember Me) and RPG (Vampyr). Each new game is an original creation with unique narrative gameplay experience and game mechanics.  
  
In 2020, DON’T NOD expanded internationally by creating its first branch in Montreal.  
  
At DON’T NOD Montreal, we celebrate diversity and inclusivity within our games as well as our teams. We commit to equal opportunities and non-discrimination in our hiring process. We are respectful of the principles of equal employment opportunities, and that is why we encourage women, people of all sexual orientations and gender identities, First Nations people, people living with a disability, visible minorities, as well as any other person who can contribute to the diversity of our studio to apply for our positions.

Is DON'T NOD involved in publishing games, or do they solely focus on development?

DON'T NOD operates as both a video game developer and publisher. This dual role allows them to not only create engaging games but also to manage the publishing process, ensuring that their titles reach a wider audience while maintaining creative control over their projects.

What platforms does DON'T NOD develop games for?

DON'T NOD develops games for multiple platforms, including PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. They also explore opportunities for mobile gaming and other emerging platforms, aiming to make their games accessible to a broad range of players.

How does DON'T NOD approach storytelling in their games?

Storytelling is a core element of DON'T NOD's game design philosophy. The studio emphasizes character-driven narratives, allowing players to make choices that impact the story's outcome. This approach fosters emotional connections between players and characters, enhancing the overall gaming experience.

Can independent developers collaborate with DON'T NOD?

Yes, DON'T NOD is open to collaborations with independent developers. The studio values creativity and innovation in game development and often seeks partnerships that align with their vision. Interested developers can reach out through their official website to explore potential collaboration opportunities.

What industries does DON'T NOD cater to with their games?

DON'T NOD primarily caters to the entertainment industry through video game development and publishing. About Muller Construction Supply
--------------------------------

Established in 1962, Muller Construction Supply offers a complete line of concrete accessories to contractors in Northern California. We provide the link between manufacturers of specialty construction materials and the users of these products, and we have developed long-term relationships with local and national manufacturers of quality construction products. Muller Construction Supply places emphasis on products that are related to concrete construction, and our customers include building, engineering, concrete, electrical and plumbing contractors.  
  
Muller Construction Supply operates a distribution center in San Jose and a sales office and warehouse in San Francisco. At a separate location in Richmond, Muller Products Corporation, dba Sansoe Concrete Specialties manufactures snapties, inner rods and other wire products.  
  
Muller Construction Supply employs and retains experienced personnel at all levels of the business, and maintains a fleet of delivery vehicles to provide daily service in our marketing area. Northern California contractors depend upon Muller Construction Supply for quality product, accurate information, prompt delivery and straightforward business support.  
  
To continue our mission of service to the industry, we have established an Employee Stock Ownership Plan, and as of March 2002 we became a 100% employee owned company. In 1962, Joe Muller, our founder, set the standard for service in our industry; as employee-owners, we will continue to meet that standard in the future.

About CPPRRG
------------

CPP strives to keep independent physicians independent. In order to achieve this goal, CPP provides physicians and other healthcare professionals with professional liability insurance and a customized safety and risk management program.As a mutual insurance company, the members are the policyholders and primary focus of CPP. There are no stockholders or owners of the group other than policyholders. We actively seek to reduce the cost of providing professional liability insurance to our members. We accomplish this through our business strategy – we are physician directed, invest in quality, maintain underwriting discipline, maintain loss control efforts, and our decisions are made by our Board of Directors which is comprised of member physicians.In the professional liability insurance industry, CPP is set apart. The CPP safety and risk management program is integrated into every insured’s practice and includes a robust, comprehensive program provided by a team of healthcare lawyers, patient safety and risk-management professionals, physicians, and nurses. The program is designed to enhance patient safety and mitigate liability risk. CPP’s unique loss control and risk management program has a proven record of favorably impacting the frequency and severity of claims.Assistance with controlling your risk starts the minute you join CPP, and when it matters most you have immediate access to risk management professionals and legal counsel. CPP’s defense of claims is proactive rather than reactive and uses cutting edge strategies. You have the full support of seasoned experts in healthcare risk management and law from the day you are introduced to the program.

What services does DeVries Public Relations offer?

DeVries Public Relations specializes in a range of services including media relations, brand storytelling, social media strategy and execution, and activation. How does DeVries Public Relations approach media relations?

Our approach to media relations is rooted in building strong relationships with journalists and influencers. We tailor our outreach strategies to align with the specific interests of the media, ensuring that our clients' stories are told in a compelling way. We also provide ongoing support to manage media inquiries and cultivate long-term partnerships.

What industries does DeVries Public Relations serve?

DeVries Public Relations serves a diverse range of industries, including consumer goods, beauty, health and wellness, and lifestyle brands. Our team has extensive experience in these sectors, allowing us to create targeted strategies that drive engagement and deliver measurable results.

Can DeVries Public Relations help with social media strategy?

Absolutely! DeVries Public Relations offers comprehensive social media strategy and execution services. We work closely with clients to develop tailored content that aligns with their brand voice and objectives, while also utilizing analytics to optimize performance and engagement across various platforms.

What is brand storytelling and why is it important?

Brand storytelling is the art of crafting a narrative that communicates a brand's values, mission, and unique selling points. It is important because it helps to create an emotional connection with consumers, differentiating the brand in a crowded marketplace. At DeVries Public Relations, we focus on developing authentic stories that resonate with audiences and drive brand loyalty.

How does DeVries Public Relations measure the success of its campaigns?

We measure the success of our campaigns through a combination of quantitative and qualitative metrics. This includes tracking media coverage, social media engagement, website traffic, and overall brand sentiment. We also conduct regular evaluations and provide clients with detailed reports to assess campaign effectiveness and inform future strategies.

About Governo do Estado de Minas Gerais
---------------------------------------

Minas Gerais conta com o maior número de municípios do país, sendo 853 cidades, que representam uma verdadeira síntese do Brasil. Localizado na região Sudeste, Minas possui mais de 586 mil km2 de área, cerca de 20,8 milhões de habitantes (IBGE, 2015) e faz divisa com os estados de São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Bahia, Espírito Santo e com o Distrito Federal.  
É uma das grandes economias do país e possui atrativos para investidores, como redução de índices de criminalidade e ações tributárias voltadas à simplificação. Destacam-se as cadeias produtivas de minério, siderurgia, agricultura e pecuária. Minas também desponta como polo tecnológico e de inovação no país. Além de concentrar o terceiro maior PIB nacional, tem o segundo maior parque industrial do Brasil, conta com seis polos de institutos tecnológicos públicos e 23 incubadoras de empresas.  
A vasta extensão territorial de Minas faz com que o Estado possua uma riquíssima variedade cultural e turística, acolhendo influências e misturas de todas as demais regiões do país, que compõem os típicos costumes genuinamente mineiros. O Estado se caracteriza por sua inigualável fauna e flora dentre seus diferentes biomas e abriga um patrimônio histórico internacionalmente reconhecido, além de belezas naturais encantadoras. Assim como a geração de empregos, a saúde, a educação e a segurança são prioridades do Governo, que cria e coloca em prática políticas públicas focadas no cidadão.  
Minas Gerais tem como governador o araxaense Romeu Zema, que concorreu a um cargo público pela primeira vez em 2018 e foi eleito no segundo turno com 71,8% dos votos válidos. Tomou posse em 1º de janeiro de 2019.

What services does The Phia Group, LLC offer?

The Phia Group, LLC provides a wide range of services focused on health care cost containment. Their offerings include comprehensive consulting services, plan document drafting, subrogation and overpayment recovery, and claims recovery. They specialize in areas such as ERISA compliance, third-party liability, the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and self-funding strategies.

How does The Phia Group assist with subrogation?

The Phia Group assists with subrogation by identifying and recovering funds from third parties responsible for injuries or illnesses that lead to claims against health plans. Their experienced team conducts thorough investigations, negotiates settlements, and ensures compliance with applicable laws, maximizing recovery for their clients while minimizing costs.

What is the importance of ERISA compliance in health care plans?

ERISA, or the Employee Retirement Income Security Act, sets standards for health care plans in private industry. Compliance is crucial as it protects the rights of plan participants and beneficiaries, ensuring they receive the benefits promised. The Phia Group helps organizations navigate ERISA requirements, ensuring their plans are compliant and reducing the risk of legal issues.

Can The Phia Group help with claims recovery for self-funded health plans?

Yes, The Phia Group specializes in claims recovery for self-funded health plans. They employ advanced techniques to identify overpayments and recover funds efficiently. Their expertise in claims analysis and negotiation helps self-funded plans minimize losses and improve their overall financial health.

What industries does The Phia Group serve?

The Phia Group serves a variety of industries, including healthcare, insurance, and employee benefits. Their clients range from self-funded employers to third-party administrators, all seeking to optimize their health care costs and improve their claims management processes.

How does The Phia Group support compliance with the Affordable Care Act (ACA)?

The Phia Group provides consulting services that help organizations understand and comply with the Affordable Care Act (ACA) requirements. They assist with plan design, reporting obligations, and compliance strategies to ensure that clients meet ACA mandates while effectively managing their health care costs.

What types of technical documentation services does JANA, Inc. offer?

JANA, Inc. provides a wide range of technical documentation services, including technical authoring, database management, and the creation of safety manuals. Our expertise extends to DITA (Darwin Information Typing Architecture), operational manuals, and SGML (Standard Generalized Markup Language) conversion. We also specialize in avionics integration engineering, component maintenance manuals, illustrated parts catalogs, service bulletins, and technical orders.

How does JANA ensure the quality and accuracy of its technical documentation?

At JANA, we prioritize quality and accuracy in all our documentation services. We employ a rigorous quality assurance process that includes multiple levels of review and validation. Our team of experienced technical authors and subject matter experts meticulously checks each document for clarity, compliance with industry standards, and technical correctness. Additionally, we utilize advanced tools and technologies to streamline the documentation process and maintain consistency.

Can JANA, Inc. assist with DITA implementation for my organization?

Yes, JANA, Inc. has extensive experience with DITA implementation and can assist your organization in adopting this structured authoring methodology. We offer consulting services to help you transition to DITA, including training for your team, developing DITA-compliant content, and integrating DITA into your existing workflows. Our goal is to enhance your documentation processes and improve content reuse and consistency.

What industries does JANA, Inc. serve?

JANA, Inc. serves a diverse range of industries, including aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and technology. Our 50 years of experience in engineering and technical documentation allows us to cater to the specific needs of these sectors, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and standards. We understand the unique challenges faced by each industry and tailor our solutions accordingly.

What is the process for creating a Component Maintenance Manual (CMM) with JANA?

Creating a Component Maintenance Manual (CMM) with JANA involves a collaborative process. Initially, we conduct a thorough analysis of your requirements and gather relevant technical data. Our team then drafts the CMM, ensuring it meets regulatory standards and includes all necessary maintenance procedures and safety information. We work closely with your subject matter experts throughout the process to ensure accuracy and completeness. Once the draft is completed, we conduct reviews and revisions before delivering the final document.

Does JANA offer services for converting existing documentation into modern formats?

Yes, JANA offers conversion services for existing documentation into modern formats, including SGML and DITA. We can help you update outdated manuals and technical documents to ensure they are compliant with current industry standards and easily accessible. Our team uses advanced conversion tools and techniques to maintain the integrity of your content while enhancing its usability and compatibility with modern documentation systems.

About Foster Care Associates
----------------------------

Foster Care Associates (FCA) is one of the UK’s largest Independent Fostering Agencies (IFA), we work in partnership with local authorities and trusts across the UK to provide high quality fostering placements for looked after children and young people.  
  
Founded in 1994, we currently provides quality care in a family setting for over 2700 looked after children and young people from all backgrounds.  
  
Through Team Parenting®, a unique approach to foster care which draws together a multidisciplinary team aimed at addressing the child or young person’s therapeutic needs, we have achieved positive outcomes for children and young people who may have experienced a number of placement breakdowns and exhibit challenging behaviours as a result of past trauma. Measurable success of Team Parenting™ includes high placement stability and impressive educational outcomes.  
  
With offices across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, we pride ourselves on the delivery of locally based support to foster carers which includes an out of hours service, supervising social worker, education officer, therapist, Children and Young People’s Support Service (CYPSS) worker and respite care as necessary to support a fostering placement. Our carers also receive a competitive professional fostering fee.  
  
We at Foster Care Associates remain committed to addressing the shortfall of nearly 10,000 foster carers across the UK through positive carer recruitment campaigns.

About Viscogliosi Bros., LLC
----------------------------

Viscogliosi Brothers, LLC (VB), headquartered in New York City, specializes in venture capital, private equity and merchant banking for the neuromusculoskeletal industry.  
  
Founded by Anthony, John and Marc Viscogliosi in 1999, the firm creates, builds, operates and finances companies founded on surgeon-developed innovation to address unmet clinical needs uniquely focused on life-changing neuromusculoskeletal technologies. VB principals have participated in more than 200 transactions, have invested in more than 20 companies and have formed nine industry-defining strategic partnerships.  
  
VB invests in technologies whose applications benefit patients and the healthcare system by improving quality of care, reducing costs, and expanding patient and provider access. With enhanced data, VB attempts to identify the technologies that best satisfy these criteria and works to transform them into successful medical breakthroughs that enable patients to regain active lifestyles.  
  
VB, its affiliates, and its partnerships have generated more than $1.5 billion in exit value on behalf of their shareholders and investor base.  
  
Through its portfolio companies, VB has defined five entirely novel orthopedic industry categories.  
  
Its investments have helped commercialize more than 75 med-tech devices, including ten number one orthopedic technologies.  
  
VB portfolio companies have sold products in more than 70 countries.  
  
VB invests its own capital in every venture, and is wholly committed to the operational, clinical, and financial success of each of its portfolio investments. Current portfolio companies within the VB ecosystem include, but are not limited to, Paradigm Spine, Centinel Spine, Woven Orthopedics Technology, Musculoskeletal Clinical Regulatory Advisers, and Aperion Biologics.

About Mission Federal Credit Union
----------------------------------

Mission Federal Credit Union (Mission Fed) is the largest member-owned, not-for-profit, full-service financial institution exclusively serving San Diego County. Mission Fed enhances the lives of its members through financial education and services, providing stability and strength to help San Diegans with financial wellness and success. Banking at Mission Fed means doing good for San Diego. Mission Fed gives money back to our local communities, has helped hundreds of nonprofits and important causes, and builds deep relationships with community partners.  
  
Mission Fed has served the financial needs of San Diegans for 60 years through checking, savings, loans, credit cards and insurance offerings. Mission Fed has in excess of $4.5 billion in assets, nearly 270,000 members, 32 convenient local branches, 30,000 fee-free CO-OP ATMs nationwide and free mobile and online banking services. Mission Fed was recognized as a 2020 Top Workplace by The San Diego Union-Tribune and named a Top Workplaces USA winner in 2021.  
  
We’re not just in San Diego. We’re part of San Diego. We are deeply connected to—and passionately embedded in—the neighborhoods of San Diego. Our belief in giving back lives on through partnerships with schools and nonprofit organizations directly committed to a stronger, vibrant, resilient and healthier San Diego County.  
  
Working at Mission Fed offers a people-focused culture with a compensation package that includes competitive pay, benefits and so much more for both full-time and part-time employees. Join a team where every single employee is a vital part of our credit union family. And as part of the Mission Fed family, you’ll benefit from working with great people, in a positive environment and have opportunities to grow professionally.  
  
We are here to enrich the lives of San Diegans and strengthen the communities we all share.  
  
Federally insured by NCUA and Equal Housing Lender

The Global Engagement Office (GEO) at The University of Nottingham Ningbo China (UNNC) plays a pivotal role in advancing the university's globalization mission. Located in the vibrant city of Ningbo, Zhejiang, GEO is committed to fostering an inclusive and culturally diverse learning environment that enriches the educational experience for both international and domestic students. By facilitating global learning opportunities, scholarships, and cross-cultural engagement, the office empowers students to achieve their personal and academic goals while cultivating a deep appreciation for diversity within the university community.  
  
GEO manages a variety of essential functions that enhance the global footprint of UNNC. These include international student recruitment, which attracts a diverse cohort of learners from around the world, and the development of international partnerships that expand the university's collaborative reach. The office also oversees students and staff mobility programs, ensuring that participants gain invaluable experiences abroad. Additionally, GEO provides comprehensive international student services, supporting newcomers as they transition to life in China. The office is instrumental in organizing global internships and summer programs, including the UNNC International Summer Program, which offers students unique opportunities to engage with global issues and cultures.  
  
For those interested in the academic aspect of GEO, a detailed teachers list is available, showcasing the diverse expertise and backgrounds of faculty members involved in global engagement initiatives. By bridging cultures and creating pathways for international collaboration, the Global Engagement Office at The University of Nottingham Ningbo China is dedicated to shaping a globally-minded educational community.

Who is the CEO of AMI?

Chip Greenberg is the CEO of AMI. To contact Chip Greenberg email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
. Or you may call +1.5058147050, +1.5052274610 or +1.5756872209

Who are the decision makers in AMI?

The decision makers in AMI are Eric Williams, Harry Myland, Jacques Geysen, etc. Click to Find [AMI decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=AMI&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of firmware solutions does AMI provide?

AMI offers a wide range of firmware solutions, including BIOS, UEFI, and EFI firmware. These solutions are designed to enhance system performance, security, and manageability across various computing platforms. Additionally, AMI specializes in Dynamic Firmware, which allows for real-time updates and orchestration capabilities, ensuring that systems remain secure and efficient.

How does AMI's Dynamic Firmware improve system security?

AMI's Dynamic Firmware enhances system security by enabling real-time updates and patches to be applied without the need for a complete system reboot. This minimizes downtime and reduces the risk of vulnerabilities being exploited. The firmware also supports advanced security features, such as secure boot and trusted platform module (TPM) integration, which help protect against unauthorized access and ensure the integrity of the system.

What industries does AMI support with its solutions?

AMI supports a variety of industries, including data centers, cloud computing, Internet of Things (IoT), and enterprise computing. Their firmware solutions are designed to meet the specific needs of these sectors, providing robust management and security features that are essential for modern computing environments. Whether it's for remote management in data centers or firmware for IoT devices, AMI's offerings are tailored to enhance performance and reliability.

Can AMI's firmware solutions be integrated with existing systems?

Yes, AMI's firmware solutions are designed for compatibility and can be integrated with a wide range of existing systems. The company provides comprehensive support for various hardware platforms, ensuring that their firmware can work seamlessly with current infrastructure. This flexibility allows organizations to enhance their systems without the need for complete overhauls, making it easier to adopt new technologies.

What is DMTF Redfish, and how does AMI utilize it?

DMTF Redfish is a standard for managing and using hardware in a datacenter. AMI utilizes Redfish to provide a modern, RESTful interface for managing servers and other hardware components. This allows for easier integration and automation of management tasks, enabling IT teams to efficiently monitor and control their infrastructure. AMI's support for Redfish enhances the manageability of their firmware solutions, making it easier for organizations to implement and maintain their systems.

What support does AMI offer for its firmware products?

AMI provides comprehensive support for its firmware products, including documentation, technical assistance, and regular updates. Customers can access a wealth of resources, including user manuals, knowledge base articles, and community forums. Additionally, AMI offers direct support for troubleshooting and implementation, ensuring that organizations can maximize the benefits of their firmware solutions and maintain optimal system performance.

About Sage Bionetworks
----------------------

Sage Bionetworks is a nonprofit biomedical research and technology development organization that was founded in Seattle in 2009. We develop and apply open practices to data-intensive research for the advancement of human health. Data-intensive research has become an important component of biomedicine, but it’s not always easy to understand how to apply computational approaches appropriately or how to interpret their results. Sage believes open practices can help. Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers work together to provide researchers access to technology tools and scientific approaches to share data, benchmark methods, and explore collective insights, all backed by Sage’s gold-standard governance protocols and commitment to user-centered design. Sage is supported through a portfolio of competitive research grants, commercial partnerships, and philanthropic contributions.  
  
Sage embraces diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to pay parity and making our salary ranges available to all employees. We invite you to apply and we welcome a conversation. We are based in Seattle, WA, and collaborate broadly throughout the world.

About Global Alliance For Africa
--------------------------------

Founded in 1996, Global Alliance for Africa partners with local African NGOs, religious institutions, and community-based organizations to design and implement innovative economic strengthening programs with the goal of enabling communities and households to provide sustainable care and support for orphans and other vulnerable children affected by HIV/AIDS.  
  
Our model of development helps households and communities to become self-reliant and to build the capacities to provide orphans and vulnerable children with shelter, education, health care, food security, psycho-social support, and legal services.  
  
We accomplish all this through our multi-dimensional approach. Our primary focus is small business development/micro-finance programs implemented with training and funding. Some examples of these businesses include green groceries, restaurants, chicken rearing, bee-keeping, and school unifrom manufacturing.

You may not know it, but Regal Rexnord impacts your life every day. Our products enable the fans in HVAC systems that keep us comfortable; the power source that keeps smart buildings running; the agricultural and food service equipment that keeps us fed; and the conveyor systems that keep e-commerce flowing. Doble Express Transport (DXT) is a premier freight distribution company based in Yennora, New South Wales, dedicated to providing exceptional logistics solutions across the region. As a wholly family-owned business, DXT places a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction, ensuring that clients are always at the heart of their operations. With a commitment to delivering a best-in-class customer experience, DXT stands out in the competitive transport industry by prioritizing reliability and service excellence.  
  
Specializing in regional freight distribution, DXT serves a diverse range of industries, including retail, manufacturing, agriculture, and construction. Their comprehensive suite of services includes road freight, warehousing, and logistics management, tailored to meet the unique needs of each client. Utilizing advanced tracking technologies and state-of-the-art logistics software, DXT ensures that shipments are monitored in real-time, providing transparency and peace of mind to customers.  
  
At Doble Express Transport, the focus is not only on moving goods but also on building lasting relationships with clients. Their team of experienced professionals is dedicated to understanding the specific requirements of each industry served, allowing them to deliver customized solutions that enhance operational efficiency. With a strong commitment to safety and sustainability, DXT continually invests in modernizing their fleet and optimizing their processes, making them a trusted partner for businesses seeking reliable freight distribution in New South Wales.

.

What types of ecological and environmental improvement projects does SumCo Eco-Contracting specialize in?

SumCo Eco-Contracting specializes in a wide range of ecological and environmental improvement projects, including restoration of natural habitats, landscaping, environmental remediation, and heavy civil construction. Our services extend to site development, bridge construction, dredging, and the management of municipal projects. We also focus on the restoration and maintenance of ponds, rivers, and dams, including dam removal when necessary.

How does SumCo Eco-Contracting ensure environmental compliance during projects?

At SumCo Eco-Contracting, we prioritize environmental compliance by adhering to all local, state, and federal regulations. Our team includes experienced scientists and engineers who conduct thorough assessments and develop project plans that minimize environmental impact. We implement best management practices (BMPs) throughout the project lifecycle and engage in continuous monitoring to ensure compliance with environmental standards.

Can SumCo Eco-Contracting assist with municipal projects?

Yes, SumCo Eco-Contracting has extensive experience working with municipal projects. We collaborate closely with local governments and agencies to deliver solutions that meet community needs while enhancing environmental quality. Our services include site development, infrastructure improvements, and ecological restoration, all tailored to support municipal objectives and sustainability goals.

What industries does SumCo Eco-Contracting serve?

SumCo Eco-Contracting serves a diverse range of industries, including municipal, commercial, and residential sectors. Our expertise in heavy civil construction and environmental remediation allows us to support developers, government agencies, and private clients in projects that require ecological restoration, site development, and infrastructure improvements.

What is the process for starting a project with SumCo Eco-Contracting?

To start a project with SumCo Eco-Contracting, clients can reach out to us through our website or contact our project management team directly. We begin with an initial consultation to understand the project requirements and objectives. Following this, we conduct site assessments and develop a comprehensive project plan that outlines timelines, budgets, and environmental considerations. Our team will guide you through each step of the process to ensure a successful project outcome.

Does SumCo Eco-Contracting offer services for dam removal?

Yes, SumCo Eco-Contracting offers specialized services for dam removal. Our team is experienced in assessing the environmental impacts of dam removal and executing the process safely and effectively. We work closely with regulatory agencies to ensure compliance and to restore the natural flow of rivers and ecosystems affected by the dam. Our goal is to enhance ecological health while addressing the needs of the surrounding community.

About Gastite
-------------

As a leading national health care advocacy organization, the National Association of Community Health Centers (NACHC) supports community-based health centers and the expansion of quality and cost-effective health care for the medically underserved and uninsured. NACHC conducts research and analysis that informs the public about the work of health centers and their value to the American health care system at the local, state and national levels. What services does the National Association of Community Health Centers (NACHC) provide?

NACHC provides a wide range of services aimed at supporting community health centers across the United States. These services include advocacy for policy changes that benefit health centers, training and technical assistance for health center staff, research and data analysis to inform best practices, and resources for improving patient care. NACHC also facilitates networking opportunities among health centers to share knowledge and strategies.

How does NACHC support access to care for underserved populations?

NACHC is dedicated to improving access to quality health care for underserved and vulnerable populations. The organization advocates for policies that increase funding and resources for Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), which serve low-income individuals and communities. Additionally, NACHC provides training and resources to help health centers effectively address the unique needs of these populations, ensuring they receive comprehensive and culturally competent care.

What are Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) and how does NACHC support them?

Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) are community-based health care providers that receive federal funding to provide primary care services in underserved areas. NACHC supports FQHCs by advocating for their interests at the national level, providing technical assistance to improve operational efficiency, and offering training programs to enhance the skills of health center staff. NACHC also conducts research to highlight the impact of FQHCs on community health outcomes.

How can community health centers benefit from NACHC's training programs?

NACHC's training programs are designed to enhance the capabilities of community health centers by providing staff with the knowledge and skills necessary to improve patient care and operational efficiency. These programs cover various topics, including clinical best practices, financial management, compliance with federal regulations, and strategies for community engagement. By participating in these training sessions, health center staff can stay updated on industry trends and improve their service delivery.

What role does NACHC play in health care policy advocacy?

NACHC plays a crucial role in health care policy advocacy by representing the interests of community health centers at the federal and state levels. The organization works to influence legislation that affects funding, regulations, and access to care for underserved populations. NACHC engages with policymakers, conducts research to inform advocacy efforts, and mobilizes its members to participate in advocacy campaigns, ensuring that the voices of community health centers are heard in the policy-making process.

How can I get involved with NACHC or support its mission?

There are several ways to get involved with NACHC and support its mission to enhance access to quality health care for underserved populations. Individuals can become members of NACHC, participate in advocacy efforts, attend NACHC conferences and training sessions, or volunteer their time and expertise. Additionally, donations and sponsorships can help fund NACHC's initiatives and programs. For more information on how to get involved, visit the NACHC website or contact their office directly.

Anita Pallenberg's legacy as an actress and artist remains a cherished and enduring influence in the worlds of film, music, and art. About South Metro Denver REALTOR Association
--------------------------------------------

The South Metro Denver REALTOR® Association, abbreviated SMDRA, is a professional organization for real estate professionals who sell real property and businesses that work in the real estate industry. SMDRA provides a variety of services to its members including education and professional development, legislative representation, networking opportunities, access to tools and resources, as well as membership in the Colorado Association of REALTORS® (CAR) and the National Association of REALTORS® (NAR). SMDRA is the second largest local real estate association in Colorado, currently with an all-time high membership of 3,700+ serviced throughout the Denver metro area. SMDRA also has approximately 240 Business Partner members in real estate related business who serve as our trusted Business Partners.Members who hold the title REALTOR® are licensed real estate professionals who choose to voluntarily subscribe to a strict Code of Ethics that is above and beyond the law. The word REALTOR® is a registered trademark that can only be used by members of a local, state and national association of REALTORS®. People who do not subscribe to the strict Code of Ethics are not members of a REALTOR® association and are simply real estate licensees.

.

What types of services does Integrity Residential Services provide?

Integrity Residential Services offers a wide range of services tailored for adults with physical and developmental disabilities and behavioral health needs. Our primary services include in-home care, residential services, direct care, nursing support, daily living assistance, behavioral health support, and self-directed services. We focus on creating personalized care plans that meet the unique needs of each individual.

How does Integrity ensure the quality of care for its clients?

Integrity is committed to providing high-quality care through a rigorous hiring process, ongoing training, and regular performance evaluations for our staff. We employ qualified professionals who are trained in best practices for supporting individuals with disabilities and behavioral health challenges. Additionally, we maintain open lines of communication with clients and their families to ensure that care is meeting their expectations and needs.

Can clients choose their caregivers at Integrity?

Yes, at Integrity Residential Services, we believe in the importance of building trust and rapport between clients and caregivers. Clients and their families are encouraged to participate in the caregiver selection process to ensure that they feel comfortable and supported. We strive to match clients with caregivers who not only meet their care needs but also align with their personal preferences and personalities.

What is self-directed service, and how does it work at Integrity?

Self-directed services at Integrity allow clients to have greater control over their care and support. This model empowers individuals to make choices about the services they receive, including selecting their caregivers and determining their schedules. Our team provides guidance and resources to help clients manage their services effectively, ensuring they have the support they need while promoting independence and self-advocacy.

What types of behavioral health support does Integrity offer?

Integrity Residential Services provides comprehensive behavioral health support tailored to the needs of individuals with mental health challenges. Our services include counseling, crisis intervention, skill-building activities, and therapeutic support. We work closely with clients to develop personalized plans that address their specific behavioral health needs and promote overall well-being.

How can families get involved in the care process at Integrity?

Families play a crucial role in the care process at Integrity. We encourage family involvement through regular communication, participation in care planning meetings, and feedback on the services provided. Our team values the insights and perspectives of family members, as they are essential in creating effective and personalized care plans that enhance the quality of life for our clients.
