About The Forest Park Conservancy
---------------------------------

Portland’s Forest Park is one of the largest urban forests in the United States, with more than 100 species of native trees, 112 species of birds and more than 60 species of mammals beneath its 5,200-acre canopy. Thousands of human visitors walk, hike, bike and run along Forest Park’s 80 miles of trails, all entirely within the Portland city limits.  
  
And yet it’s so much more than just a city park: Forest Park is where the Oregon Coast Range forest reaches east to welcome the people of Portland and tourists into its uniquely beautiful world: a vast forest ecosystem that stretches from California to Alaska.  
  
The Forest Park Conservancy is a community supported non-profit that protects and restores Forest Park. We engage more than 1,000 volunteers who give tens of thousands of hours and significant financial resources to Forest Park because, quite simply, Forest Park gives so much to us.  
  
Currently, we are leading a 20-year strategy to restore and protect the Greater Forest Park Ecosystem which is a total of 15,000 acres, including Forest Park. This strategy, called the Greater Forest Park Conservation Initiative, will play a significant role ensuring the Portland region is a healthy place to live, work, and play.  
  
We invite you to join us in our continuing work in the park, by becoming a volunteer and making a gift. You can become a part of our efforts to ensure its health for future generations.  
  
Visit us at www.forestparkconservancy.org

About Olivetta
--------------

Olivetta, created by Matt and Marissa Hermer and helmed by Executive Chef Michael Fiorelli, is a coastal European restaurant open for fine dining and late night cocktails 7 days a week.  
  
Tucked away on WeHo's Restaurant Row, the incredibly stylish 150 seat bungalow boasts an atmosphere of carefree sophistication by combining the whimsical elegance of the western Mediterranean with the theatrical exuberance of West Hollywood.  
  
By utilizing old-world ingredients and styles of preparation, Chef Fiorelli has drawn inspiration from the coastal classics of Italy, Greece, France and Spain to create a menu of contemporary dishes with a Californian sensibility. The menu captures the spirit of being on holiday while fully celebrating the exquisite locally sourced ingredients found here at home.  
  
The bar program, curated by award winning mixologist Melina Meza, pairs familiar favorites with unique ingredients to create cocktails such as a Dirty Martini made with bleu cheese infused dry vermouth, Kalamata olive brine, and a garnish of gorgonzola stuffed Castelvetrano olives as well as original creations such as a Tequila based cocktail made with elderflower, rainbow carrot, jasmine honey, Italian amaro and fresh lime. These elevated and complex flavors provide the perfect complement to Chef Fiorelli’s Mediterranean menu.  
  
The wine program, created by preeminent Sommelier Eric Railsback, represents regions from around the globe but focuses on sourcing from lesser known boutique wineries and small growers who are farming impeccably and working with great terroir. From bright, fresh, natural wines and popular favorites to back vintage burgundy and rare gems from the Old World, as well as highlights from the Hermer’s own collection, there is something for every palate on our list.

About Khalifa Fund For Enterprise Development
---------------------------------------------

صندوق خليفة لتطوير المشاريع: دعم رواد الأعمال وتطوير النظام البيئي للشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة في الإمارات العربية المتحدة  
  
يعد صندوق خليفة لتطوير المشاريع الذي تأسس في عام 2007، هيئة حكومية غير ربحية مستقلة مالياً وإدارياً تتبع حكومة أبوظبي، تنفيذاً لرؤية صاحب السمو الشيخ خليفة بن زايد آل نهيان، رئيس الدولة، حفظه الله، الرامية إلى الإسهام في تعزيز وتطوير قطاع المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة في دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة بشكل عام وإمارة أبوظبي بشكل خاص، وذلك من خلال إثراء وغرس ثقافة ريادة الأعمال في صفوف المواطنين الشباب، والإسهام في توفير بيئة أعمال ملائمة وحزمة من البرامج الشاملة والمتكاملة لدعم رواد الأعمال الإماراتيين لتلبية احتياجاتهم ومتطلباتهم كافة، لتأسيس وتنمية مشاريعهم، فضلاً عن ترسيخ مكانة الإمارات العربية المتحدة في دعم المشاريع الصغيرة والمتوسطة التي تواكب تطلعات وطموحات الحكومة الإماراتية في اقتصاد مستدام قائم على المعرفة والابتكار، وتعزيز التنافسية على الصعيدين الإقليمي والدولي.  
  
Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development: Supporting entrepreneurs and the development of the SME ecosystem in the UAE  
  
Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development was established in 2007, by the virtue of the Law 14 of 2005 and its amendments, in the implementation of the vision of His Highness Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the UAE and Ruler of Abu Dhabi. The Khalifa Fund works as an independent, not-for-profit economic development agency of the Government of Abu Dhabi for the development and support of small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs).  
  
The Fund helps to develop local enterprises in Abu Dhabi through instilling and enriching an investment culture amongst UAE nationals. The Fund also seeks to support and develop SMEs in the Emirate.  
  
Khalifa Fund was founded in 2007 with a total capital of AED 300 million, which gradually increased in 2009 to AED 1 billion, in order to meet the growing demand for the Fund’s services. In 2011, the Fund’s total capital was increase to AED 2 billion, and the Fund covered all of the UAE through a network of branches.

About Ohio Capital Corporation for Housing
------------------------------------------

The Ohio Capital Corporation for Housing (OCCH) is a nonprofit financial intermediary based in Columbus, Ohio that works with private and public developers to create affordable housing opportunities. OCCH leverages private capital for the construction, rehabilitation and preservation of affordable housing. We believe that through providing affordable housing enhanced by supportive services, we can build sustainable communities that provide opportunities and empowerment in the lives of our residents. OCCH has raised over $5.3 billion in private capital and invested in over 53,000 units of affordable housing in over 900 developments.  
  
OCCH has a lending arm, the Ohio Capital Finance Corporation (OCFC), which offers products such as predevelopment and acquisition loans to enable affordable housing development. Since its creation in 2002, OCFC has made over 675 loans totaling $583 million in production to assist in the creation, rehabilitation and/or preservation of more than 29,105 affordable housing units.  
  
OCCH created Community Properties of Ohio Management Services (CPO) in 2003 for the specific purpose of turning around a troubled portfolio of over 1,000 affordable units spread around seven Columbus neighborhoods. After a $100 million renovation effort, CPO continues to stabilize and maintain the portfolio with a hybrid of real estate management and focused supportive services. Leveraging their management expertise, CPO currently manages over 2,900 units, including units for OCCH partners.  
  
OCCH created Ohio Capital Impact Corporation (OCIC) as a 501(c)(3) non-profit to extend the mission of OCCH through creative and transformative philanthropic investments. These resources are granted to partners working creatively to improve life outcomes for residents of affordable housing communities where OCCH has investments. Since 2012, OCCH has raised over $25 million for OCIC initiatives.

About Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority (QFCRA)
---------------------------------------------------------

About Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority  
  
The Qatar Financial Centre (QFC) is the financial and business centre established by the Government of Qatar in 2005 to attract international banking, insurance business and other financial services in order to grow and develop the financial services sector in Qatar and the region.  
  
The QFC offers domestic and international firms the opportunity to establish a broad range of banking, asset management and insurance businesses under a legal and regulatory regime that meets international best practice.  
  
The Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority is the independent regulator of the QFC, established to authorise and regulate firms and individuals conducting financial services in or from the QFC. It has built a principles-based regulatory regime aligned with widely used common law, embracing transparency, predictability and accountability.  
  
In December 2012, the Law of the Qatar Central Bank and the Regulation of Financial Institutions (Law No. 13 of 2012) was enacted. The new QCB Law is an important step towards promoting financial stability across the State of Qatar and formalises the high levels of co-operation between the Qatar Central Bank, the Regulatory Authority and the Qatar Financial Markets Authority through the establishment of the Financial Stability and Risk Control Committee.

Based from our head office in Bromsgrove, we also have strategic depots in Brentwood, Bridgend, Gloucester, Hailsham, Hereford, London, Luton, NEC, Peterborough, Shrewsbury and Stoke.  
  
GTAccess are not only able to cover your local requirements, but also your National requirements through our partners within the ”Access Alliance” So call us for whatever it is you need for powered access throughout the UK.  
  
Powered Access  
  
As an independent distributor and not being manufacturer tied, you can be confident that we will offer you the platform that best suits your requirements as opposed to what best suits us.  
  
We are able to supply all manner of powered access platforms including self propelled scissor lifts, self propelled boom lifts, trailer mounted towable units, mast booms and a whole variety of specialist access platforms, so you can be assured that we will have a unit to match your specification and budget.  
  
We are also able to supply a range of used equipment for those that require this option.  
  
Training  
  
GTAccess offer a range of comprehensive training courses tailored to suit your requirements. We have over 30 years of experience with access equipment, so you can be sure that you're being trained by the experts. Training can be undertaken at any of our depots, your offices, or on site in certain circumstances. All operatives will be awarded a pass certificate on successful completion of their course which is usually valid for five years.  
  
Safety Harnesses  
  
Both IPAF and the HSE recommend that a full restraint type harness with an adjustable lanyard is worn whenever operating any form of boom lift (1b, 3b categories) These can be purchased from your local GTAccess depot.

At Arkansas Arts Academy, we believe that the arts play a crucial role in a well-rounded education. For those interested in the teaching staff, an Arkansas Arts Academy teachers list is available on our website, showcasing the diverse backgrounds and expertise of our educators. Our vibrant community encourages collaboration and creativity, allowing students to explore various artistic disciplines, including visual arts, music, theater, and dance. By fostering an environment where academic excellence and artistic expression coexist, we prepare our students not only for higher education but also for a lifetime of creativity and innovation. At Arkansas Arts Academy, we are dedicated to shaping the next generation of leaders and artists, making a lasting impact on our students and the broader community.

About Avanti's Italian Restaurant
---------------------------------

Avanti's Italian Restaurant was established in Normal, Illinois in June of 1971. Originally, the restaurant was jointly owned and managed by two brothers, Guido and Albert Zeller. In 1973, Guido bought out his brother and ran the operation as the sole proprietor until he passed away in 2002. Guido's brother Leo joined the operation in 1976 and was an integral part of the business along the way. Today, Guido's two sons, Marcus and Richard are involved in the ownership and management of the business. In June of 2009, Marcus and Richard opened a second Bloomington-Normal location at 3302 East Empire in Bloomington, Illinois. Albert now owns five Avanti’s Italian Restaurants in Peoria/East Peoria/Pekin, Illinois.  
  
Our restaurant cooks and serves home style pasta, pizza, and sandwiches that are available through dine-in, carry-out, delivery, catering and our banquet room. Avanti’s trademark however, is wonderful, fresh Italian bread which is prepared and baked in our restaurant kitchen. We have long been an institution for Illinois State University students and faculty and frequently see second generation guests and staff members.  
  
Our staff and management are experienced professionals who understand how to prepare and serve steaming hot, delicious Italian meals and fresh bread in a clean and comfortable atmosphere. Avanti’s Italian Restaurant provides a very rare combination of homelike surroundings and high quality food.  
  
Our company has developed a reputation for consistent, non-complicated dining through years of constant attention to details of our operations which include never stinting on the quality of raw food we select, nor trying to short cut its preparation. Service has been, and will continue to be, personal and friendly to every guest who enters the door.

How does Educational Connections support students with ADHD?

At Educational Connections, we understand the unique challenges faced by students with ADHD. What services does MAY Management Services offer to community associations?

How does MAY Management Services handle financial management for associations?

MAY Management Services provides detailed financial management services, including budgeting, accounting, and financial reporting. We ensure transparency and accountability by offering regular financial statements, managing reserve funds, and assisting with audits. What industries does MAY Management Services primarily serve?

About Advisory Board Centre
---------------------------

As the leading professional body for the advisory sector, the Advisory Board Centre works collectively with its members to raise the standard of the global advisory sector - driving value for professionals and the organisations they serve.  
  
For advisors we provide:  
• Professional development, executive education, recognition and certification  
• Leading market intelligence, research and best practice standard to support the quality and impact of the advisory board sector  
• Meaningful access to strong global networks for knowledge sharing and connection to opportunity  
  
Our community is one of the most engaged, value focused and professional groups of people within the sector. We support senior executives discover how they can deliver new value in their portfolio and carve out their professional pathway.  
  
For businesses we provide:  
• Education and professional development on advisor engagement and best practice advisory boards  
• Facilitate connections with the leading independent Chairs & advisors through our independent and complimentary Advisor Concierge service  
• Provide a voice for businesses to government, industry and the advisory community  
  
The Advisory Board Centre supports businesses to connect with quality advisors beyond their traditional networks via the complimentary Advisor Concierge service. This is key to creating a results oriented, best practice advisory board that is fit for purpose and tailored to your specific business needs.  
  
The Advisor Concierge service gives you access to an exclusive network of industry leaders, successful entrepreneurs and connected executives that know how to get things done. Our members are highly experienced in working with businesses with $1.5- $100M+ turnover via formalised advisory boards and strategic advisor engagements.  
  
Formalised advisory boards are a proven management tool that can support businesses to increase sales and productivity and build internal confidence in decision-making and strategy execution.

About Abraxis BioScience
------------------------

Abraxis BioScience is a fully integrated biotechnology company dedicated to delivering progressive therapeutics, such as ABRAXANE, and core technologies that offer patients and medical professionals safer and more effective treatments for cancer and other critical illnesses.  
  
Abraxis' portfolio includes the world's first and only protein-based nanoparticle chemotherapeutic compound. Scientists at Abraxis developed its proprietary tumor targeting system known as the nab™ Technology platform, an innovative approach to treating cancer and other critical illnesses. By harnessing the unique natural properties of the human protein albumin, Abraxis' nab technology platform enables the transport and delivery of therapeutic agents to the site of disease. This revolutionary biologically interactive delivery system is being further developed with other water insoluble drugs for their potential use across a broad range of tumors.  
  
ABRAXANE® for Injectable Suspension (paclitaxel protein-bound particles for injectable suspension) (albumin bound), the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved product to use the nab platform, was launched in 2005 for the treatment of metastatic breast cancer.  
  
From the discovery and research phase to development and commercialization, Abraxis BioScience is committed to rapidly enriching the company's pipeline and accelerating the delivery of breakthrough therapies that will transform the lives of the patients who need them.  
  
Abraxis, with headquarters in Los Angeles, California, trades on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol "ABII". For more information about the company and its products, please visit www.abraxisbio.com.

About 24/7 Real Media
---------------------

24/7 Real Media, Inc., a WPP company, provides digital display marketing solutions for advertisers, agencies and publishers globally. Behind every insight, there's the experience of 18 offices in 12 countries, billions of global advertising impressions served every month and a stellar reputation as a leader in the digital marketing industry. 24/7 Real Media continues to empower advertisers and publishers to engage their audiences. With its award winning Open AdStream® ad management platform that powers its Global Web Alliance media network, 24/7 Real Media takes targeting, tracking, and analytics to the next level across digital media. The 24/7 Real Media Global Web Alliance reaches hundreds of millions of unique users every month. The media network the most advanced targeting capabilities, which include behavioral targeting, demographic targeting, daypart targeting, retargeting, geodemographic, and psychographic targeting. The Global Web Alliance also delivers advertising in any format, including the most advanced rich media and video formats. 24/7 Real Media introduced Open AdStream technology in 1995 and offered ad serving into applications in 1999. By 2000, 24/7 Real Media was serving ads into games and first implemented two-screen integrated ad delivery into DTV and Web. In September 2004, 24/7 Real Media developed Behavioral Targeting applications and a Behavioral Targeting Network. Advanced developments in prioritization and yield management, as well as automated yield management in Open AdStream were introduced in March 2005. On July 12th, 2007, WPP, the largest global communications groups, completed its acquisition of 24/7 Real Media. Regularly scheduling updates to its technology, 24/7 Real Media announced Open AdStream 11 for seamless online revenue optimization in 2011.

What industries does MicroTrain support with its training programs?

About The Debt Alternative Center
---------------------------------

The Debt Alternative Center (DAC) works primarily with debt settlement front end companies or similar companies looking to increase their service offerings.  
  
The DAC offers services in the debt settlement space including a performance model, an attorney model, along with an FDCPA + debt restructuring program.  
  
Other FTC Compliant and national complementary debt settlement services, include debt management, IRS Tax resolution, credit repair and credit restoration services, defaulted student loans and even bankruptcy.  
  
The Debt Alternative primary goal is to help as many Americans as possible who may be struggling to make ends meet. Sale reps (affiliates) and or front end shops can now offer multiple options to their individual clients instead of trying to force a particular lead/ client into a program which in turn may not be in the best interest of the client.  
  
Free to sign up, one on one training and personal account reps. Call to learn more 877-282-0555.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Nutri-Lawn

Who is the CEO of Nutri-Lawn?

.

Who are the decision makers in Nutri-Lawn?

The decision makers in Nutri-Lawn are Bill Mackenzie, Boyd R Loveless, Brent Giles, etc. Click to Find [Nutri-Lawn decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=Nutri-Lawn&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of lawn care services does Nutri-Lawn offer?

Nutri-Lawn provides a comprehensive range of lawn care services designed to nourish and maintain healthy lawns. Our offerings include weed control, insect control, aeration, overseeding, grub control, lawn fertility, installation of inground sprinkler systems, top dressing, and satellite controllers. Each service is tailored to meet the specific needs of your lawn, ensuring optimal growth and health.

How often should I have my lawn aerated?

Aeration is typically recommended once a year for most lawns, particularly in the spring or early fall when the grass is actively growing. However, the frequency may vary based on factors such as soil type, lawn usage, and overall health. Nutri-Lawn experts can assess your lawn and provide personalized recommendations for aeration to enhance root growth and improve nutrient absorption.

What is the importance of overseeding, and when should it be done?

Overseeding is the process of spreading grass seed over an existing lawn to improve its density, color, and overall health. It is particularly beneficial for lawns that are thinning or have bare patches. The best time to overseed is during the early fall or spring when temperatures are moderate, and there is adequate moisture. Nutri-Lawn can help you determine the right timing and seed type for your specific lawn conditions.

How does Nutri-Lawn handle weed control?

Nutri-Lawn employs a combination of pre-emergent and post-emergent weed control methods to effectively manage weeds in your lawn. Our trained technicians assess the specific weed types present and apply targeted treatments to eliminate them while minimizing impact on your grass. We prioritize environmentally friendly practices and use products that are safe for your family and pets.

What are the benefits of installing an inground sprinkler system?

An inground sprinkler system offers numerous benefits, including efficient water usage, consistent coverage, and reduced labor for lawn maintenance. It ensures that your lawn receives the right amount of water at the right times, promoting healthy growth and minimizing water waste. Nutri-Lawn provides expert installation and maintenance services to ensure your system operates effectively throughout the seasons.

Can Nutri-Lawn help with lawn fertility, and what does that involve?

Yes, Nutri-Lawn specializes in lawn fertility services that involve assessing soil health and nutrient levels to develop a customized fertilization plan. This includes applying the right type and amount of fertilizer to promote healthy grass growth, improve color, and enhance resilience against pests and diseases. Our experts will work with you to create a schedule that aligns with your lawn's specific needs.

About USA Basketball
--------------------

Based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, USA Basketball is a nonprofit organization and the national governing body for men's and women's basketball in the United States. As the recognized governing body for basketball in the United States by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA) and the United States Olympic Committee (USOC), USA Basketball is responsible for the selection, training and fielding of USA teams that compete in FIBA sponsored international basketball competitions, as well as for some national competitions, and for the development of youth basketball initiatives that address player development, coach education and safety.  
  
Serving since January 2001 as CEO is Jim Tooley, who has been with USA Basketball since 1993.  
  
From 2013 through 2016, 2,211 men and women players and 250 coaches participated in USA Basketball, including USA Basketball men’s and women’s five-on-five and 3x3 teams, USA Basketball trials and USA team training camps.  
  
USA Basketball men’s and women’s teams between 2013-17 compiled a spectacular 157-4 win-loss record in FIBA and FIBA Americas competitions. Additionally, USA 3x3 teams posted an 89-17 win-loss record in official FIBA and FIBA Americas 3x3 competitions.  
  
USA Basketball ranks No. 1 in all five of FIBA's world ranking categories, including combined, men's, women's, boys and girls.  
  
The USA Basketball Youth Development division is tasked with the development of youth basketball initiatives that address player development, coach education and safety, while promoting, growing, and elevating the game. USA Basketball is committed to providing youth throughout the country safe, fun and developmentally appropriate environments in which they can enjoy the game.  
  
Current USA Basketball youth initiatives include coach licensing and education; organization accreditation; coach academies; regional camps; youth clinics; open court programs; Women in the Game conferences; and the U.S. Open Basketball Championships.

About ZIEHL-ABEGG SE
--------------------

ZIEHL-ABEGG (Künzelsau, Germany) is one of the leading global companies in the field of ventilation, control and drive technology. In the 1950s, ZIEHL-ABEGG established the basis for modern fan drives: external rotor motors which even today are still seen as state-of-the-art worldwide. Another area of business is electric motors which provide the power, for example, for elevators, medical applications (computer tomography equipment) or deep-sea underwater vehicles. The high-tech company has an impressive innovative capability.  
  
ZIEHL-ABEGG employs 2,800 personnel in its production plants in Southern Germany. The company has a global workforce of 5,100 spread between 15 production plants, 30 companies and 117 sales locations. The products, approx. 30,000 in all, are sold in more than 100 countries. Turnover in 2022 totaled 873 million euros.  
  
Emil Ziehl founded the company in Berlin in 1910 as a manufacturer of electric motors. After the Second World War the company’s headquarters were relocated to Southern Germany.

About Minnetonka Public Schools
-------------------------------

The Minnetonka Public School District is a high performing school district proudly serving families in all or part of 10 communities: Minnetonka, Chanhassen, Deephaven, Eden Prairie, Excelsior, Greenwood, Shorewood, Tonka Bay, Victoria and Woodland.  
  
We serve approximately 11,100 students in grades K-12. Our students attend one of six elementary schools, two middle schools, and one high school. We also have Tonka Online, a fully online K-12 program, and SAIL (Students Achieving Independent Life) which serves students ages 18-21 with special needs. All six of our neighborhood elementary schools offer English and either Spanish or Mandarin Chinese Immersion, as do our two middle schools. We are a leader in using technology as an accelerator to learning. We offer computer coding, beginning in Kindergarten, and we offer a 1:1 iPad program for all students, K-12.  
In addition, our birth-to-5 Early Childhood Family Education Program serves families and children during the most critical early developmental years.  
  
We are a great place to work:  
\* High quality teaching staff committed to student growth  
\* Financial stability with no budget cuts in nearly 20 years  
\* Visionary Superintendent and supportive administration  
\* Dedicated parent, neighborhood, and business communities  
\* Growing student enrollment  
\* Ongoing professional development and leadership opportunities  
\* Expanding Fine Arts program  
\* State test scores are among the best in the state  
\* Robust technology plan which has given teachers the tools to accelerate student learning  
  
With a focus on 21st century skills, we educate the whole student. Our high quality staff is committed to helping each student develop the knowledge, skills, confidence and character to thrive in a changing world.

BAUR is always one step ahead. Constant innovations in power generation and distribution demand quick adaptation of the measurement and testing technology. To meet these requirements, BAUR bets on maximum flexibility and continuous consolidation of its core competencies: Cable testing and fault location, diagnosis and evaluation of reliability of cable systems and dielectric insulation material tests. At BAUR, we have merged long years of experience and passion for technology with the ambition for continuous advanced technological development.  
  
BAUR customers include power station companies, network operators, public utility companies as well as industrial and service companies around the world. Intensive contact with customers and consistent implementation of their expectations for technical solutions are given the highest priority at BAUR.

Amy Klobuchar is a force to be reckoned with in the world of American politics. Serving as a United States Senator since 2007, she has consistently demonstrated her dedication to public service, pragmatic approach, and tireless advocacy for the American people. Klobuchar's remarkable career is defined by her ability to transcend party lines, forge bipartisan relationships, and deliver tangible results for her constituents.  
  
Born and raised in Minnesota, Klobuchar developed a deep appreciation for public service at an early age. Inspired by her father's work as a prominent journalist and her mother's dedication to volunteerism, she pursued a career in law and politics. After earning her law degree from the University of Chicago, Klobuchar embarked on a path that would lead her to become one of the most influential voices in the Senate.  
  
Throughout her tenure in Congress, Klobuchar has established herself as a champion for middle-class families, an advocate for affordable healthcare, and a fierce defender of consumer rights. She has worked tirelessly to strengthen the economy, create jobs, and ensure equal opportunities for all Americans. Klobuchar played a pivotal role in passing the Affordable Care Act, which extended health insurance coverage to millions of uninsured Americans, and she continues to fight for its protection and expansion.  
  
One of Klobuchar's most impressive qualities is her ability to find common ground and build bridges within the deeply polarized world of American politics. She is renowned for her pragmatic approach, diligently working across party lines to pass legislation that benefits the American people. With a reputation for reaching across the aisle, Klobuchar has been instrumental in forging bipartisan relationships, a skill that has helped her advance critical legislation, including criminal justice reform, addiction recovery efforts, and infrastructure development.  
  
In addition to her legislative accomplishments, Klobuchar has emerged as a leading advocate for campaign finance reform and election security. Recognizing the corrosive influence of dark money on American democracy, she has championed transparency, integrity, and accountability in the electoral process. Klobuchar's unwavering commitment to fair and accessible elections has earned her widespread respect from both sides of the aisle.  
  
Beyond her policy achievements, Klobuchar possesses an uncanny ability to connect with people on a personal level. Her radiant charisma, quick wit, and down-to-earth demeanor have endeared her to voters across the nation. She brings a refreshing authenticity to the political arena, consistently demonstrating her deep understanding of the challenges facing everyday Americans.  
  
Amy Klobuchar's political leadership extends beyond the confines of the Senate. In 2019, she launched a historic bid for the presidency, capturing the nation's attention with her bold policy proposals, pragmatic approach, and unwavering determination. Although her presidential campaign did not ultimately succeed, Klobuchar's impact on the national stage was undeniable, and she has since returned to the Senate even more determined to effect change.  
  
As the United States faces unprecedented challenges in the 21st century, Amy Klobuchar stands ready to lead the charge. With her unique combination of unwavering integrity, pragmatic leadership, and passion for public service, she serves as an inspiration to countless Americans, reminding them of the transformative power of politics done right. Whether fighting for healthcare, combating climate change, or advocating for social justice, Klobuchar has dedicated her life to making America a better place for all.

What services does Future Fields offer in the field of biotechnology?

Future Fields specializes in biomanufacturing and the production of recombinant proteins, particularly through the innovative use of fly biotechnology. Our services include the development and optimization of growth factors, which are crucial for various applications in research and therapeutic development. We aim to provide scalable and sustainable solutions for the production of high-quality biological materials.

How does Future Fields' fly biotechnology differ from traditional methods?

Future Fields utilizes Drosophila melanogaster, commonly known as fruit flies, as a platform for biomanufacturing. This approach offers several advantages over traditional methods, including faster production times, lower costs, and a reduced environmental footprint. Our fly-based systems can produce complex proteins and growth factors with high efficiency, making them an attractive alternative for researchers and companies in need of reliable biological materials.

What industries can benefit from Future Fields' solutions?

Future Fields' solutions are applicable across a variety of industries, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and academic research. Our growth factors and recombinant proteins are essential for drug development, regenerative medicine, and various research applications. By providing innovative biomanufacturing solutions, we support advancements in health and medicine, ultimately contributing to improved outcomes for patients and society.

Can Future Fields customize growth factors for specific research needs?

Yes, Future Fields offers customization services for growth factors and recombinant proteins to meet the specific requirements of our clients. We work closely with researchers and companies to understand their unique needs and can tailor our products accordingly. This flexibility allows us to support a wide range of applications and enhance the effectiveness of research and development projects.

What is the timeline for receiving products from Future Fields after placing an order?

The timeline for receiving products from Future Fields can vary depending on the specific product and customization requirements. Generally, our standard lead time for non-customized products is between 4 to 6 weeks. For customized solutions, we will provide a detailed timeline during the initial consultation process. We prioritize timely delivery while ensuring the highest quality standards for our biomanufactured products.

How does Future Fields ensure the quality and safety of its biomanufactured products?

At Future Fields, we adhere to strict quality control and assurance protocols throughout the biomanufacturing process. Our facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art technology, and we follow industry best practices to ensure the safety and efficacy of our products. Additionally, we conduct rigorous testing and validation of our growth factors and recombinant proteins to meet the highest standards required for research and therapeutic applications.

About Janssen De Jong Bouw Zuid B.V.
------------------------------------

Janssen de Jong Bouw – Ruimte voor mensen  
  
Ieder mens heeft ruimte nodig. Om te wonen, te werken, te ontspannen. Janssen de Jong Bouw geeft die ruimte. Letterlijk. Door te bouwen aan woonwijken en huizen, zorginstellingen en bedrijfsruimten creëren we ruimte om te ademen, te leven en te genieten.  
  
Al meer dan 75 jaar heeft Janssen de Jong Bouw haar wortels stevig verankerd in de woningbouw. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn woningbouwcorporaties, gemeenten, ontwikkelaars, bedrijven en particulieren. Janssen de Jong Bouw is tevens een actieve partner in de utiliteitsbouw, zo realiseren we een grote verscheidenheid aan bedrijfsgebouwen, zorgcentra, onderwijsinstellingen en kantoren. Daarnaast zijn wij actief op het gebied van Bouwservice een renovatie.

---------------------

Celebrity makeup artist Jeanine Lobell founded Stila in 1994. The Company name is derived from the Italian word "stilare," which means "to pen". Stila believes that makeup should be as individual as each woman's own signature. Stila creates products for the eyes, cheeks, lips and face as well as for complexion perfection and multi-use. The Company also sells brushes and accessories. Stila’s modern, uniquely illustrated and inspiring packaging is made out of recycled materials that are durable as well as distinctive. Stila has also continually sought new ways to teach makeup techniques, either over the Internet or within the product container. Today, Stila is known for its modern, sophisticated, non-intimidating approach to beauty. The brand's innovative, multi-tasking formulas, eco-friendly packaging, and fashion-forward colors have cemented its place on must-have lists of top beauty editors around the world. The prestige color brand regularly appears on the pages of magazines like Allure and InStyle, and is also used by top designers during New York fashion week.

About SOAR Transportation Group
-------------------------------

In 2018, Kelle’s Transport Service LLC (KTS) became SOAR Transportation Group. Our team of dedicated professionals strives for quality performance in all realms of the business — from drivers to driver support. Backed by one of the country’s finest fleets of trucks and trailers, equipped with state-of- the-art freight tracking capability to ensure load safety and visibility, our team is highly experienced and dedicated to safety. It ensures the well-being of ourselves, our customers and the general public, but it is also the right thing to do. We are connected by a system of communication that ensures the honest, relevant, and essential information is relayed between the office, the cab, and the customer- the instant it becomes available. We provide long haul and regional transportation that is built on the foundation of performance from quality solutions to quality customer service.

With a passionate commitment to its customers, Inter-County not only meets the needs of the bakery industry but also fosters lasting partnerships that drive mutual success. Whether you are a small artisan bakery or a large-scale commercial operation, Inter-County Bakers Inc. is your trusted partner in achieving baking excellence.

We are always looking to add talented sales representation. Please contact us threw this site to explore the possibility of joining the Electropac family.

About TriCab Engineered Cable Systems
-------------------------------------

Tricab is the worlds most flexible cable manufacturer, not only in terms of product, but also in terms of working with customers to develop custom engineered solutions for their needs.  
  
TriCab Group is a well established and highly regarded Australian cable manufacturer. We provide a comprehensive range of flexible cables that are designed to simplify installation across a wide range of applications. In broad terms, we service commercial and industrial customers from our manufacturing facilities in Port Melbourne, USA and Thailand.  
  
Our Company originated in Australia over 40 years ago. In addition to the 3 Manufacturing facilities, we also have 20 Sales/Distribution offices throughout Australia, New Zealand, Asia and the USA. Our products are highly regarded throughout the world in terms of quality, safety and value. We have constantly evolved and improved our processes and technologies, whilst understanding the importance of simplicity regarding business transactions.

At TriCab, we are committed to being "Employer of Choice". Our people enable us to provide great product and service to our customers. We therefore, do everything we can to attract, develop and keep the very best people.  
  
The competitive nature of our business requires TriCab to promote and sustain a dynamic work environment. In return there are great opportunities to develop your career while being rewarded and recognised for your contribution.  
  
TriCab is always looking for motivated and driven new staff at all levels of our operation. We seek out people who share our values and our commitment to innovation, excellence, health and safety. Please see below to view our current vacancies, globally. Please also note that we always welcome applications, even if there does not appear to be a current vacancy. We have a Continual Employment policy, that enables us to always find meaningful employment for talented individuals.  
  
Equal Employment Opportunities  
TriCab is dedicated to developing a diverse work environment in which employees at all levels are treated fairly and with respect. We recognise that it is the differences in our employees that contribute to the success of the business. We endeavour to realise these differences and combine the unique skills experiences and perspectives that each individual brings.

What types of power supplies does GlobTek offer?

GlobTek provides a wide range of power supplies, including standard AC/DC power supplies, custom power supplies tailored to specific needs, medical power supplies that meet stringent safety standards, and USB power supplies for various applications. Additionally, they offer waterproof power supplies suitable for outdoor and harsh environments.

Can GlobTek create custom battery packs for my specific application?

Yes, GlobTek specializes in designing and manufacturing custom battery packs. They work closely with clients to understand their specific requirements, including size, capacity, and application, to create battery packs that meet those needs. Their expertise in battery technology ensures high performance and reliability.

What industries does GlobTek serve?

GlobTek serves a diverse range of industries, including medical, telecommunications, industrial, and consumer electronics. Their products are designed to meet the unique demands of these sectors, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

Are GlobTek's products compliant with international safety standards?

Yes, GlobTek's products are designed and manufactured to comply with various international safety standards, including UL, CE, and FCC certifications. This ensures that their power supplies and battery solutions are safe and reliable for global use.

What is Power Over Ethernet (PoE) and how does GlobTek implement it?

Power Over Ethernet (PoE) is a technology that allows electrical power to be transmitted along with data over standard Ethernet cables. GlobTek offers PoE solutions that enable devices such as IP cameras, VoIP phones, and wireless access points to receive power and data through a single cable, simplifying installation and reducing costs.

How can I request a quote for GlobTek's products or services?

To request a quote for GlobTek's products or services, you can visit their website and fill out the contact form or reach out directly to their sales team via email or phone. Provide details about your specific requirements, and they will respond promptly with a tailored quote.

About Knights of Columbus, Father Roach Council 3217
----------------------------------------------------

Thanks to the efforts of Father Michael J. McGivney, assistant pastor of St. Mary’s Church in New Haven and some of his parishioners, the Connecticut state legislature on March 29, 1882, officially chartered the Knights of Columbus as a fraternal benefit society. The Order is still true to its founding principles of charity, unity and fraternity.  
  
The Knights was formed to render financial aid to members and their families. Mutual aid and assistance are offered to sick, disabled and needy members and their families. Social and intellectual fellowship is promoted among members and their families through educational, charitable, religious, social welfare, war relief and public relief works.  
  
The history of the Order shows how the foresight of Father Michael J. McGivney, whose cause for sainthood is being investigated by the Vatican, brought about what has become the world's foremost Catholic fraternal benefit society. The Order has helped families obtain economic security and stability through its life insurance, annuity and long-term care programs, and has contributed time and energy worldwide to service in communities.  
  
The Knights of Columbus has grown from several members in one council to more than 14,000 councils and 1.8 million members throughout the United States, Canada, the Philippines, Mexico, Poland, the Dominican Republic, Puerto Rico, Panama, the Bahamas, the Virgin Islands, Cuba, Guatemala, Guam and Saipan.

About TECO-Westinghouse Motors (Canada) Inc.
--------------------------------------------

TECO-Westinghouse Motor Company and Westinghouse Electric Corporation have a long and proud history of providing motors to the North American marketplace. Our history dates back to George Westinghouse introducing the DC Motor line in 1888, and Westinghouse Electric marketing the world’s first commercial AC motor in 1894. Today, TECO-Westinghouse Motors (Canada) Inc. remains the market leader for the supply of electric motors and controls. As early as 1976, TECO Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd. entered the US market. In 1987, the motor production and marketing division of Westinghouse Electric Co. Ltd., a US company of over 100 years of history, merged with TECO to form a joint venture named “Westinghouse Motor Company”. In April 1995, TECO Electric & Machinery made the acquisition of Westinghouse Motor Company, making it a 100%-TECO owned enterprise. TECO formally changed the company name to TECO-Westinghouse Motors (Canada) Inc., which handles all the Canadian marketing, sales, and product services for TECO and TECO-Westinghouse branded motors manufactured in Taiwan and Malaysia. As a world leader in manufacturing electric motors and generators, our product line includes low, medium, and high voltage (up to 13,800 volts) premium efficiency and high performance motors, ranging from 1/4 HP to 100,000 HP. We are also a leader in supplying motor controls, and providing engineering services, genuine Westinghouse renewal parts and large motor repairs.

About Olivetta
--------------

Olivetta, created by Matt and Marissa Hermer and helmed by Executive Chef Michael Fiorelli, is a coastal European restaurant open for fine dining and late night cocktails 7 days a week.  
  
Tucked away on WeHo's Restaurant Row, the incredibly stylish 150 seat bungalow boasts an atmosphere of carefree sophistication by combining the whimsical elegance of the western Mediterranean with the theatrical exuberance of West Hollywood.  
  
By utilizing old-world ingredients and styles of preparation, Chef Fiorelli has drawn inspiration from the coastal classics of Italy, Greece, France and Spain to create a menu of contemporary dishes with a Californian sensibility. The menu captures the spirit of being on holiday while fully celebrating the exquisite locally sourced ingredients found here at home.  
  
The bar program, curated by award winning mixologist Melina Meza, pairs familiar favorites with unique ingredients to create cocktails such as a Dirty Martini made with bleu cheese infused dry vermouth, Kalamata olive brine, and a garnish of gorgonzola stuffed Castelvetrano olives as well as original creations such as a Tequila based cocktail made with elderflower, rainbow carrot, jasmine honey, Italian amaro and fresh lime. These elevated and complex flavors provide the perfect complement to Chef Fiorelli’s Mediterranean menu.  
  
The wine program, created by preeminent Sommelier Eric Railsback, represents regions from around the globe but focuses on sourcing from lesser known boutique wineries and small growers who are farming impeccably and working with great terroir. From bright, fresh, natural wines and popular favorites to back vintage burgundy and rare gems from the Old World, as well as highlights from the Hermer’s own collection, there is something for every palate on our list.

We believe that a company's values are as important as the products it makes. We know that plant-based products can provide exceptional efficacy, and that products designed from renewable plant-based ingredients are better for the planet than products made from petroleum. In 1841, Clemens & August Brenninkmeijer launched a small Dutch textile company called C&A. The brothers’ vision was as simple as it was revolutionary: “Offering good quality ready-to-wear clothing at affordable prices.” 175 years later we’ve grown into one of the most trusted value fashion retailers across the globe. We may have evolved to look very different, but on the inside we are still the same.  
  
C&A China began store operations in the spring-summer season of 2007, and has set up a local full value China operation. This means that not only C&A China operates stores here, also the design, producing, and market merchandising is done independently for the Chinese customer.  
  
Localization is one of C&A’s key strengths in this dynamic, growing and competitive market. Bringing international retail expertise and global fashion trends along with fostering local talents, establishing a first class local infrastructure, and incorporating Asian design, handwriting and fitting into their product lines; C&A China continues to strengthen its position as a major player in the Chinese fashion retail market.

AM Best rating services assesses the creditworthiness of and/or reports on over 16,000 insurance companies worldwide. Our credit ratings are independent, indicative and interactive, and summarize our opinion on an insurance company’s ability to pay claims, debts and other financial obligations in a timely manner. Our commentary, research and analysis provide additional insight.  
  
AM Best information services integrates credit ratings, commentary, research and analysis with insurance news, financial data and thought leadership to help consumers and professionals make more informed personal and business decisions. About GENFIT
------------

We are a biopharmaceutical group conducting late stage clinical trials dedicated to improving the lives of patients with liver diseases with high unmet medical needs, with a special focus on rare, severe and acute pathologies.  
  
With our rich scientific heritage spanning more than two decades, we are a pioneer in the discovery and development of drugs for liver diseases.  
  
Thanks to our expertise in bringing early-stage assets with high potential to late development and pre-commercialization stages, today we boast a growing and diversified pipeline of innovative therapeutic and diagnostic solutions. Our portfolio now covers six therapeutic areas with six drugs at different development stages (preclinical, Phase 1, Phase 2 and Phase 3), with different mechanisms of action: elafibranor in Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC), nitazoxanide (NTZ) and VS-01-ACLF in Acute on Chronic Liver Failure (ACLF), GNS561 in cholangiocarcinoma (CCA), VS-02-HE in Hepatic Encephalopathy (HE) and VS-01-HAC in Urea Cycle Disorder (UCD) and Organic Acidemia (OA).  
We also work on non-invasive diagnostic solutions in nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) and ACLF, essentially to identify patients eligible for treatment alongside our therapeutic programs in ACLF.  
  
Our workforce is spread over 3 sites: Lille and Paris (France), Zurich (Switzerland) and Cambridge (Massachusetts, United States).  
GENFIT is a publicly traded company listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and on compartment B of Euronext’s regulated market in Paris (Nasdaq and Euronext: GNFT). In 2021, IPSEN became one of GENFIT’s largest shareholders and holds 8% of the company’s share capital. www.genfit.com  
  
Please view our community guidelines here: https://www.genfit.com/social-media-community-guidelines/

About Econo-Courier, ECI Transport, Inc
---------------------------------------

Econo-Courier began in 1972 as a man with one van and a great idea— to provide fast, reliable and economical courier services, trucking, logistics & warehousing to businesses in the New York metropolitan area. Over time we grew from a Man-In-A-VanSM to a team of drivers, dispatchers, and more.  
  
We are now located in Parsippany, NJ in our 35,000 square foot warehouse and have an expansive fleet that consists of cars, vans, trucks, and tractor trailers. We deliver packages of all sizes throughout the entire North East region for customers across the country.  
  
Years of experience and exceptional service have earned us the business of companies from a variety of industries, including healthcare, manufacturing, printing, and construction, among others. We have also partnered with other logistics companies to offer last-mile shipping services.  
  
In addition to millions of packages and envelopes, we have been trusted to transport a very interesting array of cargo including a submarine propeller, an inaugural gown, and transplant organs. We’ve taken packages in our trucks to planes that we’ve chartered or to other shipping centers to get the job done. There’s no package too unique and no journey too unusual for our team!  
  
Customers have trusted us for more than 45 years because we’ve stayed committed to our original mission, even as we’ve grown. We make fast, reliable service our priority for every customer. And, our team is made up of professionals that do more than just deliver – they understand the specific needs of our customers, adjust their service accordingly, and do it all with courteousness and care.  
  
We’ve remained a family business through and through – staying rooted in our traition while keeping an eye toward continuous innovation and adapting to smarter business practices.  
  
Get to know Econo-Courier for yourself! Reach out to us today to learn more about how we can support your shipping needs.

Reliability is at the core of Econo-Courier's operations. About EFGH - Education Francaise Greater Houston
------------------------------------------------

Education Française Greater Houston (EFGH) is a premier nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting French language education in the Greater Houston area. Established in 2010 by a passionate group of volunteers, EFGH addresses the growing demand for French classes tailored for both native and non-native speakers aged 4 to 18. As the only provider in Houston offering a comprehensive year-long French program for children enrolled in American schools, EFGH plays a vital role in fostering bilingualism and cultural appreciation among its students.  
  
Operating from September to May on Saturday mornings, EFGH's curriculum is designed to enhance language skills while immersing students in the rich traditions of French culture. The organization is recognized as an Association FLAM (Français Langue Maternelle) by the French Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the AEFE (Agence de l’Enseignement du Français à l’Etranger), and the French Consulate in Houston, underscoring its commitment to high-quality education.  
  
Parents seeking to enroll their children can find detailed information about the EFGH - Education Francaise Greater Houston teachers list on the official website. The dedicated educators at EFGH are not only proficient in the French language but also bring a wealth of experience and enthusiasm to the classroom, ensuring that each student receives personalized attention and support. Through engaging lessons and interactive activities, EFGH nurtures a love for the French language, preparing students for a globalized world where bilingualism is an invaluable asset. Join EFGH in celebrating the beauty of the French language and culture, and give your child the gift of language that lasts a lifetime.

Who are the decision makers in EFGH - Education Francaise Greater Houston?

The decision makers in EFGH - Education Francaise Greater Houston are Christelle Wojciak, Efgh Directeur, Marie Crespel, etc. Click to Find [EFGH - Education Francaise Greater Houston decision makers emails](https://contactout.com/dashboard/search?company=EFGH%20-%20Education%20Francaise%20Greater%20Houston&seniority=founder%7Cc_suite%7Cvice_president%7Cowner%7Cdirector)
.

What types of French language programs does EFGH offer?

EFGH offers a variety of French language programs tailored to different age groups and proficiency levels. These include French as a Foreign Language (FLE) courses for adults and children, French immersion programs for kids aged 4-18, and specialized French language classes for Francophone children (FLAM). Additionally, EFGH hosts French immersion summer camps that provide an engaging environment for children to learn French while participating in fun activities.

Are the French language classes suitable for beginners?

Yes, EFGH provides classes for all proficiency levels, including complete beginners. Our experienced instructors are trained to create a welcoming atmosphere where students can learn at their own pace. We offer introductory courses that focus on basic vocabulary, pronunciation, and conversational skills, ensuring that beginners build a solid foundation in the French language.

What age groups does EFGH cater to for its French language programs?

EFGH caters to a wide range of age groups, offering French language education for children as young as 4 years old up to 18 years old. Our programs are designed to meet the specific needs of each age group, ensuring that the learning experience is age-appropriate, engaging, and effective. We also offer adult classes for those looking to learn or improve their French skills.

What is the structure of the French immersion summer camps?

The French immersion summer camps at EFGH are designed to provide an immersive language experience through a combination of structured learning and fun activities. Campers engage in language lessons, cultural activities, arts and crafts, and outdoor games, all conducted in French. This approach helps children develop their language skills in a natural and enjoyable setting, promoting both language acquisition and cultural appreciation.

How can I enroll my child in a French language program at EFGH?

Enrolling your child in a French language program at EFGH is easy! You can visit our website at http://www.efghouston.org to find detailed information about our programs, schedules, and registration process. Alternatively, you can contact us directly via email or phone for assistance with enrollment and to discuss which program would be the best fit for your child's needs.

Does EFGH offer any resources for parents interested in supporting their child's French language learning?

Yes, EFGH provides various resources for parents to help support their child's French language learning. We offer workshops and informational sessions that equip parents with strategies to reinforce language skills at home. Additionally, we provide recommendations for books, online resources, and activities that can enhance the learning experience outside of the classroom. Our goal is to create a supportive community for both students and their families.

Following the merger of Perini Corporation and Tutor Saliba Corporation in 2008, Perini Management Services, Inc. (PMSI) is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tutor Perini Corporation, specializing in design-build construction for U.S. federal agencies, both within and outside the continental United States. We also provide construction services for U.S. multi-national firms and select foreign governments. We are known for our ability to execute complex construction projects within aggressive schedules and to a high level of quality.  
  
Worldwide Construction Expertise - Originally incorporated as Perini International, PMSI has successfully constructed many logistically challenging projects in more than 70 countries. Many of these projects were located in underdeveloped countries and/or remote locations and we have developed the expertise to plan, schedule and mobilize materials, equipment and labor to successfully execute construction under the most difficult conditions.  
  
Design-Build Expertise - As the government has moved steadily towards design-build as a preferred method of project delivery, so too has PMSI. The majority of our task order work over the past 10 years has been for design-build construction. In the execution of more than $1.5 billion in design-build projects, we have developed management practices that enable us to work closely and efficiently with a number of design firms to deliver facilities that meet our clients’ specified requirements and budgets.

About Mission Therapeutics
--------------------------

Mission Therapeutics is a private, drug discovery and development company focused on selectively targeting deubiquitylating enzymes to treat diseases of high unmet need.  
  
Mission has built a world-leading platform for the discovery and development of first-in-class, small-molecule drugs that selectively target deubiquitylating enzymes (DUBs) – an emerging, and hitherto intractable, drug class that is attracting significant commercial interest as the potential ‘Next Kinase Area’.  
  
Mission’s DUB platform is yielding a rich pipeline of novel therapeutics for the benefit of patients across therapeutic areas.  
  
Mission’s strategy is to create value by advancing its pipeline programmes through early clinical development, and preferentially with a patient selection strategy to enhance the probability of demonstrating early signs of efficacy.  
  
Mission’s leadership team has a wealth of international, commercial and scientific experience, and the company has strong links with key academic and research centers including Cancer Research UK Laboratories and the Jackson Laboratories at the Gurdon Institute, University of Cambridge.  
  
The Company has to date received £87 million in venture capital from a blue chip syndicate comprising institutional and corporate investors and was awarded a £1.9 million grant from Innovate UK in September 2015.  
  
In February 2016, the Company raised £60 million in a Series C financing led by Imperial Innovations and new investor Woodford Patient Capital Trust. It included follow-on investment from existing shareholders Sofinnova Partners, SR One, Roche Venture Fund and Pfizer Venture Investments. Mission is based at the Babraham Research Campus, south of Cambridge.

What is Mission Therapeutics and what do they specialize in?

Mission Therapeutics is a private drug discovery and development company that focuses on selectively targeting deubiquitylating enzymes (DUBs) to develop innovative therapies for diseases with high unmet medical needs. Their specialties include oncology, neurodegeneration, and drug discovery, leveraging their world-leading platform to advance treatments for conditions such as cancer and neurodegenerative diseases.

How does Mission Therapeutics' platform work?

Mission Therapeutics has developed a proprietary platform that enables the identification and optimization of small molecule inhibitors that target deubiquitylating enzymes. These enzymes play a crucial role in regulating protein degradation and cellular signaling pathways. By selectively inhibiting DUBs, Mission aims to restore normal cellular function and address the underlying causes of various diseases, particularly in oncology and neurodegeneration.

What types of diseases does Mission Therapeutics aim to treat?

Mission Therapeutics is primarily focused on treating diseases with high unmet medical needs, particularly in the fields of oncology and neurodegeneration. This includes various forms of cancer, where they aim to enhance the effectiveness of existing therapies, as well as neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, where they seek to address the underlying molecular mechanisms contributing to disease progression.

What is the significance of deubiquitylating enzymes in drug discovery?

Deubiquitylating enzymes (DUBs) are critical regulators of protein stability and function within cells. They remove ubiquitin tags from proteins, which can influence various cellular processes, including cell cycle regulation, apoptosis, and DNA repair. By targeting DUBs, Mission Therapeutics aims to modulate these processes to develop novel therapeutic strategies that can improve patient outcomes in diseases such as cancer and neurodegeneration.

Is Mission Therapeutics involved in collaborations or partnerships?

Yes, Mission Therapeutics actively seeks collaborations and partnerships with academic institutions, pharmaceutical companies, and research organizations. These collaborations are aimed at advancing their drug discovery programs, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of new therapies targeting deubiquitylating enzymes. Such partnerships enhance their capabilities and broaden the impact of their research in the field of drug development.

About Roche Diagnostics Belgium
-------------------------------

Roche is a global pioneer in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics focused on advancing science to improve people’s lives. The combined strengths of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics under one roof have made Roche the leader in personalised healthcare – a strategy that aims to fit the right treatment to each patient in the best way possible.  
  
Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management.  
  
Founded in 1896, Roche continues to search for better ways to prevent, diagnose and treat diseases and make a sustainable contribution to society. The company also aims to improve patient access to medical innovations by working with all relevant stakeholders. Thirty medicines developed by Roche are included in the World Health Organization Model Lists of Essential Medicines, among them life-saving antibiotics, antimalarials and cancer medicines. Moreover, for the tenth consecutive year, Roche has been recognised as the most sustainable company in the Pharmaceuticals Industry by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI).  
  
The Roche Group, headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, is active in over 100 countries and in 2017 employed about 94,000 people worldwide. In 2017, Roche invested CHF 10.4 billion in R&D and posted sales of CHF 53.3 billion. Genentech, in the United States, is a wholly owned member of the Roche Group. Roche is the majority shareholder in Chugai Pharmaceutical, Japan.

Above all else, our focus is producing quality products and providing excellent customer service. We are 100 percent committed to exceeding your expectations in products and service as you find solutions for your health and footcare needs.  
  
Almost half a century later, under the leadership of President and CEO Steven B. Smith, Spenco is a dynamic, entrepreneurial company that has evolved into one of the world's leading footcare brands. Our products are sold in over 84 countries around the world.  
  
Our Mission  
If you have ever had sore, tired feet, a blister or a pressure sore, you will understand that we mean it when we say that our mission is to help you will feel better when you use Spenco® Products.  
  
“When you feel better, your life is better. Life in your shoes is certainly better!”

About InnoCare Pharma 诺诚健华(HKEX：09969)

InnoCare Pharma is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and commercializing best-in-class and/or first-in-class drugs for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases.  
  
InnoCare has strong in-house innovation capabilities, holding multiple foreign and domestic patents with a rich product pipeline target liquid tumors, solid tumors, and autoimmune diseases. Our team has discovered and developed  
a strong pipeline, including one commercial drug BTK inhibitor orelabrutinib, 11 drug candidates on phase I/II/III clinical stage and 5 on IND-enabling stage.

Our core R&D staff brings rich experience from the world's top pharmaceutical companies, such as Pfizer, GSK, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Merck, Johnson & Johnson, Bayer, etc. We are a truly global biopharmaceutical company with sites in Beijing, Nanjing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, Hong Kong and Unites States.  
  
On March 23, 2020, InnoCare officially listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (code: 9969).  
  
Our vision is to become a world-class biopharma leader to address the unmet medical needs globally.

The Native American Community Academy (NACA), located at 1000 Indian School Rd NW in Albuquerque, New Mexico, is a unique educational institution dedicated to fostering the growth of Native American students through a culturally relevant curriculum and community engagement. NACA's mission is to empower students, educators, families, and the broader community to collaborate in creating an environment that nurtures academic excellence, personal identity, and healthy lifestyles. By focusing on developing strong leaders, NACA prepares its students not just for academic success, but also for meaningful contributions to their communities as they transition from adolescence to adulthood.  
  
At NACA, the emphasis is on a holistic approach to education that integrates Native American culture and values into the learning experience. This commitment is reflected in the diverse and dedicated team of educators, which can be explored through the Native American Community Academy teachers list available on their website. These educators are not only skilled in their respective fields but also deeply invested in the cultural and personal growth of their students. By fostering a sense of belonging and identity, NACA ensures that students are not only academically prepared but also secure in their heritage.  
  
Through innovative programs and community involvement, NACA aims to create a supportive environment where students thrive academically and personally. The academy stands as a beacon of hope and a model for culturally responsive education, demonstrating how schools can effectively serve Native American communities while preparing the next generation of leaders.

JobKing has a global reach, with job listings available in various regions, including Singapore, Dubai, Kuwait, Qatar, and many more. The platform caters to job seekers looking for opportunities in the hospitality industry and other sectors across these locations.

Setting up job alerts on JobKing is easy! Simply create an account on the platform, and you can customize your job alert preferences based on your desired job title, location, and industry. You will then receive notifications via email whenever new job listings that match your criteria are posted.

About National Jewish Health
----------------------------

For more than 124 years, National Jewish Health has been at the forefront of research and medicine. We integrate the latest scientific discoveries with coordinated care for pulmonary, cardiac, immune and related conditions. National Jewish Health physicians and researchers are at the forefront of a new era in health care that embraces a personalized, preventive approach to medicine.  
  
We understand that each person is unique, and their variations in diet, environment, personal habits and DNA all influence their individual health. That is why two different people are exposed to certain conditions and only one gets sick and why certain treatments may work for one person and not for another. With a focus on personalized medicine, our researchers are looking at environment-gene interaction and making strides in predicting, preventing, treating and tracking many diseases. This proactive approach to medicine means that if you have a disease, or the probability of getting a disease, it may be detected sooner so that you may live longer, healthier and with a better quality of life.  
  
Our research is truly transforming the lives of millions. By using an individual's DNA to predict and prevent disease, to guide the right choice of therapy to limit side effects and bring higher success rates for treatments and to be able to track the effects of these therapies, National Jewish Health is working to improve health care for the future.

Primark is an international clothing retailer employing more than 70,000 colleagues across 16 countries in Europe and the US. Founded in Ireland in 1969 under the Penneys brand, Primark aims to provide affordable choices for everyone, from great quality everyday essentials to stand-out style across women’s, men’s and kid’s, as well as beauty, homeware and accessories. With a focus on creating great retail experiences in-store, Primark continues to expand across new and existing markets with the aim of reaching 530 stores by the end of 2026.  
  
Primark is working to make more sustainable fashion affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is its commitment to doing better, every day - making more sustainable products everyone can afford, reducing its impact on the planet and improving the lives of workers. It has made a series of public commitments it plans to work towards and report on progress each year. These include making all its clothes from recycled or more sustainably sourced materials, ensuring clothing is recyclable by design, halving carbon emissions across the value chain and pursuing a living wage for workers in the supply chain.

About MusclePharm, Corporation
------------------------------

COMPANY OVERVIEW  
  
MusclePharm® is an award-winning, worldwide leading sports nutrition & lifestyle company offering branded nutritional supplements. Its portfolio of recognized properties include the MusclePharm® Sport Series, Essentials Series, and recently-launched Natural Series, as well as FitMiss™ – a product line designed specifically for female athletes. MusclePharm® products are available in more than 100 countries globally, with its Combat Protein product lineup being the company’s most popular.  
  
The Athlete’s Company – as it’s known within the sports nutrition world – has a reputation for high-quality, safe, effective and clinically-proven supplements, helping athletes everywhere achieve goals related to strength, lean muscle growth, endurance, weight-loss, rapid recovery, athletic performance and general wellness. MusclePharm® products have been developed through a six-stage research process, utilizing the expertise of leading nutritional scientists, physicians and universities, and have been rigorously tested for banned substances by the third-party quality assurance program Informed-Choice.  
  
OUR PROMISE  
  
At MusclePharm®, we promise to develop and bring to market the safest, most effective and rigorously tested nutritional and sports supplementation products possible. The purpose of every MusclePharm® product is to enhance an athlete’s performance and health – all without the use of banned substances.  
  
Our team philosophy is We Live This, meaning that – as current and former athletes – we only make products that we personally believe in and use every single day.  
Company Values  
  
• BUILD CONFIDENCE  
• BRING PEOPLE TOGETHER  
• NEVER STOP GRINDING  
• LEAD BY EXAMPLE
